launches.title: ⭐Laserfocus - Implement streamlined Salesforce processes for agile GTM teams
launches.tagline: Laserfocus makes your sales process as simple as possible, but not simpler
launches.body:
Okay, maybe it's our german OCD, but we can't stand it if products are not organized, fast and efficient.

But why do sales organizations let a clunky Salesforce setup slow them down?

#### **😐 The problem for GTM teams**

Companies that scale their GTM rely on Salesforce as the source of truth for all customer data. And they mostly rely on their Sales team to capture that data. But processes and data requirements change fast and different stakeholders just add more data fields into their CRM until it becomes too cluttered to be usable.

We found that the average Salesforce instance has 757 fields to maintain and update. It's a nightmare.

Your GTM team probably suffers from:

* loss of sales productivity due to time spent updating instead of selling
* messy and duplicate data that needs constant manual clean up so you can run reports

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64170&key=user_uploads/363716/44be1f1b-c7e5-484c-92cb-82b43aa0b072)

You hire more revenue operations to babysit and micromanage salespeople to follow the (overcomplicated) sales process.

#### **🧿 Introducing Laserfocus - Implement streamlined Salesforce processes for agile GTM teams**

We believe a tool should help the salespeople understand what action brings the most value to them and the company. And it should be agile enough so the sales organization can adapt to the fast-changing market conditions sales teams face daily.

Laserfocus makes the sales process as simple as possible, but not simpler:

* Maximizes the time salespeople can spend on selling by showing them what they need to focus on
* Ensures that all data lands into Salesforce in the proper fields so you can make informed business decisions instead of pulling it from different shadow systems

Oh, and it's super fast and delightful to use. You can see a short 48-second demo preview here:
[![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64170&key=user_uploads/363716/c28243e4-549e-404c-8666-9338c65858fe)](https://videos.laserfocus.io/c1Hxnq)

#### **👀 How to try Laserfocus**

Anyone on your team with a Salesforce license can sign up for our free basic version at [www.laserfocus.io](http://www.laserfocus.io)

Or you can schedule a demo at <https://calendly.com/lasertalk/daniel>

We're giving all YC co's 20% discount for 6 months on the **Team** plan.

launches.title: Warmly - Always-On AI Sales Agent for Your Website
launches.tagline: AI that gives demos, qualifies leads, and books meetings on your website 24/7
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋 We're Max, Carina and Alan, founders of Warmly.ai.

**TL;DR**: We just launched **AI Autopilot**: an always-on agent that lives on every page of your website, identifies visitors at the person level before any form fill, gives demos, qualifies prospects, books meetings, and retargets the rest. Customers running it are converting 30% more inbound traffic. Setup is a script tag and 30 minutes.

Launch announcement [here](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/) (would greatly appreciate a comment!).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHybZmEzyTs>

**The Problem**

Most B2B SaaS companies are bleeding pipeline through their front door.

Your website is your highest-leverage asset. Every visitor you've paid for lands there. They often have the problem you solve but you just might not be fast enough to get to them in time before they leave or go to a competitor.

Buyers now expect to talk to someone immediately. They don’t want to wait a day to schedule a call with an SDR to get a basic question answered.

But every "AI chatbot" we've seen since 2023 has the same architecture under the hood: a stateless GPT wrapper that rebuilds context from scratch on every message, hallucinates, and hands off "qualified" leads with no traceability.

AEs aren’t fans and buyers see through them in two messages.

**What we built**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkvDdJCsqd8>

AI Autopilot is one agent on every page of your site. It pulls from your website, help center, internal docs, sales calls, sales methodologies, and CRM.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/3ec0d6d3-bdec-4a67-9c20-5937dd63216d)

It picks its own qualification path. It generates slide decks on the fly mid-conversation, triggers the right videos by intent, and offers an optional video avatar so visitors talk to a person instead of a widget.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/368692f0-3842-48b8-8297-2cdd41ab78d7)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/e3d90e0a-3c84-418b-b28e-445d7ee67dd4)

When the visitor doesn't book? AI Autopilot doesn't give up. It Slacks your team, sends a personalized follow-up email, and triggers LinkedIn retargeting for your top prospects.

It self-improves.

It analyzes every conversation against the goals you set, tunes itself, and is version controlled. You can watch it get better over time.

In our beta accounts, automated inbound meetings increased 30%.

**Why now**

We started out compiling signals for B2B sales/marketing teams, like person-level website visitor data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/49b7ce12-478d-4b6f-a812-7a0810f6272a)

In the past year we took a different bet: build a context graph for B2B GTM first, then put agents on top of it.

The context graph is a unified, real-time data layer that connects every signal, action, note, and outcome for every account. When AI Autopilot engages a visitor, it knows they saw your LinkedIn ad last week, your SDR sent a follow-up email yesterday, and they downloaded a case study an hour ago. It doesn't have to "look this up.” The context is already pre-computed in primitive stores it can query in milliseconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/784e00dd-623d-42b2-94e4-fc67416b54a0)

A blog post we wrote that covers how we think about the GTM space: [GTM Brain: Next Platform Owns Decisions, Not Data](https://www.warmly.ai/blog/gtm-brain).

**Asks for the YC community**

1\. **Drop us a comment on our [launch post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/)**. We’d love for more of our community to know us for building GTM agents and not just supply GTM data :).

2\. **Try us out.** Book a demo with us if this is something you’re interested in! <https://www.warmly.ai/p/book-a-demo>

Warmly,

Max, Carina & Alan

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** **Vogent's Voice Agent Wizard uses AI trained on thousands of real agent designs to generate complete, ready-to-deploy voice agents from a simple description and any relevant files**

https://youtu.be/IKisqK4cO5U

Building a performant voice AI agent today means weeks of trial and error—clicking through dashboards, configuring countless parameters, testing edge cases, and waiting on support tickets. By the time you've iterated your way to something that works, your competitors have shipped and your launch momentum is gone.

**Introducing Vogent's Voice Agent Wizard.** Trained on thousands of real agent design processes, our wizard understands what makes voice agents work in production. Just describe what you want your agent to do, attach a few transcripts or conversation examples, and it builds a complete, production-ready voice agent in minutes—not weeks.

The wizard handles everything: reasoning through the right agent architecture for your use case, configuring optimal parameters, generating appropriate system prompts, and even anticipating edge cases based on patterns it's learned from real deployments. What used to take experienced engineers days of iteration now happens automatically.

launches.title: Vogent Turn: State-of-the-art Turn Detection for Voice AI
launches.tagline: Stop interrupting; teach your AI when to wait, and when to speak
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Vogent-Turn-80M is a state-of-the-art turn-detection model that detects when users are done speaking with extraordinary accuracy, so your voice AI can stop interrupting.**\
\
https://youtu.be/XQeSUc2ID6g

What makes conversation feel natural isn't just what we say; it's knowing when to speak and when to listen. Current voice AI systems struggle with this fundamental challenge, either interrupting users mid-thought or waiting awkwardly long after they've finished. The problem? Existing turn detection relies on either audio-only signals (missing semantic context) or text-only analysis (losing critical vocal cues). When a user says "I'm flying from San Francisco..." are they pausing to think, or done answering? Audio and text alone can't tell; but humans know instantly.

**Introducing Vogent-Turn-80M**. Vogent-Turn-80M solves this by doing what humans do naturally: processing both how you're speaking and what you're saying simultaneously. Built on a streamlined 80M parameter architecture, our model fuses acoustic features from audio with conversational context from text, enabling it to understand that "123 456" with rising intonation means more is coming, while "I'm departing from San Francisco" is incomplete when asked about two airports. This multimodal approach achieves 94.1% accuracy while running in just \~7ms on a T4 GPU—fast enough to feel completely natural in real-time conversations.

The result? Voice agents that finally feel like talking to a human. No more frustrating interruptions. No more awkward pauses. Just natural, flowing conversation that responds at the right moment, every time.

Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/vogent/Vogent-Turn-80M

GitHub: https://github.com/vogent/vogent-turn

Blog Post: https://blog.vogent.ai/posts/voturn-80m-state-of-the-art-turn-detection-for-voice-agents

New open-source text-to-speech models come out every week, with many ranking as state-of-the-art on popular benchmarks.

However, most of these models are not readily usable for high-volume, low-latency inference. Additionally, some research preview models can struggle with hallucinations and inconsistent outputs. Finally, as with any model, hosting yourself and managing compute can be a headache.

Voicelab solves these problems:

1. Voicelab maintains a proprietary inference stack that is optimized to serve text-to-speech transformers efficiently and scalably.
2. Voicelab post-trains select models to improve consistency and offer high-quality professional voice clones.
3. Voicelab manages all compute, so you can pay for these models per-character instead of managing GPUs.

All of this is exposed through a standard text-to-speech API (with streaming/websocket support) and an online playground.

launches.tagline: Vogent is the all-in-one platform for building effective voice agents quickly
launches.body:
**TL;DR**: [**Vogent**](https://vogent.ai/) is an all-in-one platform for building voice agents by using intelligent building blocks, including drag-and-drop conversational flow builders, IVR detection models, spelling-optimized voices, custom phone-ready LLMs, and more. Vogent is made for developers and no-code users alike.

<https://youtu.be/mu1rHsGjiMU>

# The Problem

We’ve spent the past year building high-volume voice AI agents for a number of big-ticket customers, including the second largest prescription network in the US, the biggest flight and hotel booking sites in Europe, top-10 health insurance companies, car dealership chains, and more.

While the core voice agent cycle (STT-LLM-TTS-VAD) is a mostly solved problem at this point, the last-mile problem for making these agents performant was frustrating. We ended up building a lot of band-aids, and we decided to consolidate all of the tools that we used to build these agents into a self-serve platform for developers and non-developers alike.

# How Vogent Works

Voice AI isn’t new, and neither are platforms to build agents. Our approach is to also offer higher-level building blocks that make it easier to build performant agents that can handle complex tasks. These include:

* Our drag-and-drop flow builder, which lets teams build agents that are both conversationally flexible and aligned to a task.
* Our counterfactuals feature, which lets you test new agents on past calls
* Our IVR detection model, which can tell the difference between a human or prerecorded message and navigate the latter
* Custom, in-house voices that are optimized for realistic numbers and spelling
* LLMs fine-tuned on millions of phone conversations that can be easily prompted to follow phone-call tasks

As well as other powerful abstractions.

Our other focus is providing as much to developers as possible. We expose most of our platform through GraphQL and REST APIs, and we have a JS SDK that makes voice as easy to add to your product as any other AI modality. (Mobile SDKs in beta – email [j@vogent.ai](mailto:j@vogent.ai) for access!)

launches.title: Elto AI: The AI that makes phone calls
launches.tagline: Elto is an AI that talks on the phone, automating tasks in healthcare, operations, staffing, government, and more.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Elto AI is a highly authentic, low-latency conversational AI that can make phone calls. Elto has automated phone calls to/for health systems, insurance providers, pharmacies, staffing agencies, municipalities, and more. Get a call from the AI at <https://elto.ai>!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80688&key=user_uploads/539546/d298a29f-a5c3-4cde-a2c4-d2455baa28be)

Elto is an end-to-end platform for training, deploying, and monitoring AI voice agents that make phone calls.

### The Problem

Phone calls are the most reliable way to execute tasks and receive information, whether it’s checking the status of an insurance claim or canvassing potential voters. Unfortunately, making phone calls is expensive, time-consuming, and resource-intensive; an offshore human caller can only make 100-300 dials a day, and increasing the number of humans dialing adds management burden. Making calls time-sensitive only adds to the operational complexity.

Others’ attempts to solve this problem with AI fall short; chaining together out-of-the-box API’s makes conversational agents that are difficult to train and **very** slow to respond.

### Our Solution: Custom, Low-Latency Voice Agents

It took a while for us to get here -- we tried to get a version of this working a year ago by naïvely chaining together transcription, language, and text-to-speech services, but we ran into the problem that most AI voice agent solutions have: the latency was too high, instructing unspecialized models to execute tasks on the phone was difficult, and the realism was just not there.\
\
Fast-forward a few months; our parallel dialer ([eltodialer.com](http://eltodialer.com)) was growing quickly, and we realized that it gave us what we needed to fix our earlier issues: from a small subset of consenting customers, we were able to gather troves of conversational data to train condensed, specialized models that were low-latency and worked well on the phone with prompting and few-shot fine-tuning. The dialer also gave us robust infrastructure for serving and monitoring hundreds of thousands of dials a day.\
\
We've used that data and infrastructure to build an end-to-end in-house pipeline for training easy-to-teach, low-latency, realistic voice agents, and have worked with a handful of pilot customers to get the agents to execute tasks consistently. Elto's AI now runs tens of thousands of dials daily with no human oversight, automating work for verticals from logistics providers and healthcare payers to staffing solutions and municipalities, and more, with failure rates lower than those of human callers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80688&key=user_uploads/539546/05909c0f-0456-453f-b49a-94de17a161ca)

\
\
We're now making the platform generally available on an invite basis. Sign up for an invite on the site!\
\
Note: we _do not_ support sales use-cases for Elto AI, due to TCPA regulations. Check out our parallel dialer ([eltodialer.com](http://eltodialer.com)) instead!

launches.title: Elto - AI-powered parallel dialer
launches.tagline: 10x your cold-call volume with AI
launches.body:
TLDR: Elto dials up to 6 prospects at once, detects when a human picks up, and immediately drops the user into the call. Spend less time waiting on dial tones and voicemail, and more time on the phone with engaged prospects. 

Hey everyone, 

We’re Jagath and Vignesh, and we’re building Elto. Elto is an AI-powered parallel dialer that makes cold-calling _way_ less painful and more productive. 

**The Problem** 

Cold-calling _sucks_. Sitting through dozens of dial-tones and voicemail inboxes can be exhausting and demoralizing, and while getting on the phone with an engaged prospect can be magical, it’s easy to go through multiple _days_ without a productive conversation. With a 3% pickup rate, for example, it can take **2 hours** of dialing to get a prospect on the phone (let alone a prospect who converts!).

**The solution**: Elto **dials 6+ contacts in parallel, detects when someone answers, and connects the pickup to the user.** The rest of the calls disconnect immediately, so they can be re-dialed later.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72727&key=user_uploads/539546/969b79ec-53c4-4439-9a66-aa85c97fa272)

Using Elto increases the number of engaged leads on the phone in a single calling session by an **order of magnitude**. It also integrates seamlessly with your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.) and/or SEP ([Apollo.io](http://Apollo.io), Salesloft, Outreach, etc.), so you can import contact lists/sequences/due call tasks and write call recordings, transcriptions, and dispositions back to your platform of choice.

**Want to get started?** [Schedule a time to get set up.](http://calendly.com/elto/elto_get_started)

launches.body:
Hey YC Community, Carlo here. Today we’re making FirstQuadrant available for the public! This one’s been a long time in the making.

Anand and I started working on this over 2.5 years ago (before ChatGPT was even released). And to be honest, it took a lot of fucking around and finding out. We spoke to over 300+ founders and heads of sales, rebuilt the product from scratch multiple times, and only after countless conversations did it finally click.

So today, we’re excited (and a bit nervous) to finally release FirstQuadrant to the public: An AI sales execution platform that helps founders and revenue teams move faster, stay organized, and close more deals, by streamlining the behind-the-scenes sales-work so nothing ever slips through the cracks.

https://youtu.be/UG5RfdbKPfI

**The Problem:** 

If you’ve ever looked inside a CRM, you know how chaotic things can get. Deals are scattered, updates are missed, and there’s always this underlying anxiety: “Did I forget to follow up?” “Am I waiting on someone to respond?” “Did I send the right documents?”

Most sales reps are great at conversations and closing — but not at the repetitive, behind-the-scenes tasks before and after meetings. That’s where deals fall through the cracks.

**The Solution:**

FirstQuadrant solves these exact problems. Our platform analyzes all your sales conversations and uses advanced AI reasoning to understand where each deal stands and what should happen next.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90182&key=user_uploads/569815/03bcb01a-7e6c-4c01-bb08-0a37d57a6a3f)

It automatically manages tasks like:

\- Following up with leads

\- Rescheduling missed meetings

\- Qualifying new inbound leads

\- Staying in touch with old or inactive contacts

\- Sending resources or summaries post-call

All of this is handled in the background, giving your sales team the mental space to focus on what really matters: selling, meeting with customers, and building relationships.

As a result, your deals move faster, your pipeline gets cleaner, and your reps aren’t constantly playing catch-up.

They don’t have to keep everything in their heads anymore. FirstQuadrant tracks it all and nudges them at just the right moments.

And beyond just managing active deals, it also helps uncover hidden revenue by reactivating older, inactive business relationships (the ones reps never quite get around to following up with). And on the top-of-funnel side, it qualifies new leads that come in, lets you build custom-qualified audiences, and even runs AI-personalized outbound email campaigns at scale. So you’re filling your pipeline with high-quality leads and keeping everything organized and moving forward — all in one place.

**About us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90182&key=user_uploads/569815/59265b17-f07b-4a4f-ad44-1fa30b6f6091)

Anand (CTO/CPO) is a technology entrepreneur, engineer, and designer. Previously, he founded the accessibility tech startup Oswald Labs and the fashion e-commerce company Melangebox at the age of 18. Carlo (CEO) is a Swiss-born serial entrepreneur. Before founding FirstQuadrant, he established a Swiss design agency at the age of 20 and bootstrapped it to over 40 employees and multiple millions in revenue. He has been recognized by the EY Entrepreneur of the Year award and listed in Forbes' 30 Under 30.

**Ask & Give**

If you’ve felt the pain of busy-work in sales, we’d love for you to check out our launch. [Head over to Product Hunt and tell us what you think. ](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/firstquadrant)

We’re super excited to share what we’ve built — and even more excited to learn from you all. Thanks for checking out FirstQuadrant.

launches.tagline: Run more outbound calls with embedded power and parallel dialing, a live Salesfloor, and real-time coaching in one platform.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112632&key=user_uploads/832328/f3d998f2-1dec-4aa3-b5ce-2e40154d9dfd)


![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112632&key=user_uploads/832328/88403df8-0b92-475b-bde6-87ed22e349db)


![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112632&key=user_uploads/832328/fb0a9225-9c8c-4266-8352-9a976fe560e6)

Hey everyone — we're Ajinkya and Craig from Trellus (YC W22).

**TL;DR:** Trellus combines embedded power and parallel dialing, a collaborative Salesfloor, and live AI coaching in one product. Reps can dial up to five lines from supported CRM, sales-engagement, prospecting, and spreadsheet workflows. Managers can run call blocks, listen to live calls, coach reps, and pull people into private huddles without leaving the floor. Trellus is typically about half the price of Nooks for teams buying a comparable dialing and Salesfloor workflow.

## The problem

Outbound teams usually stitch together a dialer, their CRM or sales-engagement platform, a virtual sales floor, call recording, analytics, and a coaching tool. Reps bounce between tabs. Managers see the call after it is over. Remote call blocks lose the energy and fast feedback of a real sales floor.

We built Trellus so the list, the call, the team room, and the coaching loop can stay connected.

## What a call block looks like in Trellus

1. A rep opens the workflow they already use in a supported platform such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Attio, lemlist, GoHighLevel, or Google Sheets.
2. Trellus adds one-line power dialing or up to five-line parallel dialing directly to that workflow, so the rep does not have to rebuild the list in a separate dialer.
3. The team joins a shared Salesfloor to dial together, see who is active, chat, and celebrate wins.
4. Managers can listen to live calls and coach in the moment. Trellus can also surface real-time guidance for objections, discovery, pacing, and next steps.
5. When a conversation needs privacy, a manager can pull a rep or small group into an audio huddle and return them to the shared floor when it is over.
6. Calls are transcribed and available for team analytics and review after the block.

## One product for the whole calling workflow

* Embedded power dialing and up to five-line parallel dialing
* Voicemail drops, phone-number rotation, and number-health workflows
* A live Salesfloor for remote and hybrid call blocks
* Private manager-rep huddles inside the floor
* Live listening and real-time coaching
* Transcripts, call review, scoring, and team analytics
* Practice conversations with AI roleplay bots

Trellus works on top of the sales tools your team already uses, so reps keep the account context and workflow they know. You get the high-volume dialing and collaborative floor experience without buying a separate product for every step.

## Why we think this matters

Nooks helped establish the modern parallel-dialer-plus-salesfloor category. Trellus gives teams that same core buying outcome—more live conversations and a shared place to run call blocks—while adding embedded workflows and live coaching in one product at roughly half the price.

We are building for sales leaders who want more activity without treating reps like call-center seats, and for reps who want help during the conversation rather than another dashboard after it.

## Our ask

If your team runs outbound call blocks, try Trellus and tell us where your current workflow breaks. We are especially interested in feedback on embedded dialing, live manager coaching, and how remote teams use private huddles during a floor session.

Watch the [two-minute product walkthrough](https://www.tella.tv/video/2-min-trellus-walkthrough-9b4y).

See [Trellus for sales teams](https://www.trellus.ai/sales?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=salesfloor_launch_2026).

[Try Trellus](https://app.trellus.ai/install?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=salesfloor_launch_2026).

**TLDR**: [_Trellus_](https://trellus.ai/) _is an_ [_AI powered real time sales coach_](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-does-real-time-sales-ai-coaching-work) _for sales development reps in their cold calls. It guides reps to exceed quota by identifying common situations in sales calls and delivering simple action-oriented suggestions at the moment they are needed. Trellus also completes all post-call work for reps including note-taking and call summarization._ [_Real-time AI is the future of sales support_](https://www.trellus.ai/post/real-time-ai-sales-coaching) _- check out our chrome extension today_ [_here_](https://app.trellus.ai/install-now)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94302&key=user_uploads/832328/a165ef44-7cbf-407c-9c33-2bd363d0af1f)

# **The Problem**

**For sales reps** - it is hard to master all the skills necessary to have consistent and repeatable success in prospecting calls. A few examples of what reps need to stay on top of in each call:

1. Who the prospect is and how to build rapport
2. [What to respond to common cold call objections](https://www.trellus.ai/post/five-common-cold-call-objections)
3. Any qualification questions that need to be worked through - and the prospect's response
4. Their own delivery cadence - tempo, talk time, etc.
5. When to go for the close and book the next steps

**For managers** - it is hard to effectively supervise and train a team of reps since a team of reps has far more (combined) hours to make calls than a manager has time to review them. Existing sales intelligence tools like Gong / Chorus are commonly used for recording and review but offer limited help in coaching reps because [the analytics are less focused on prospecting calls and the feedback is often delayed.](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-coaching-is-broken)

# **The Solution**

Trellus solves these issues by giving your sales reps a real-time AI-powered sales coach that is available 24x7 to them. Trellus enables your reps to deliver the right message at the right moment to your prospects.

We do this by mixing a blend of behavioral and content coaching suggestions to help your sales reps learn best-in-class sales techniques.

### **Features**

* Seamless integration into your dialer platform of choice (it’s as simple as downloading our chrome extension)
* Behavioral coaching on monologues, cadence with a whole host of features coming soon (filler words, pauses, tone)
* Objection handling for classic cold call objections (e.g., “I’m not interested) with the ability for your sales enablement team to customize suggested responses for your reps
* Battle cards for competitors (e.g., “I use X”) - whenever one of your competitors is mentioned on a call, your rep will get suggested talking points
* Real-time transcription for all your dials
* Real-time localized data on your prospects (e.g., news, weather) to provide additional data sales reps can leverage to build repertoire
* Automatic call summarization and disposition entry

### **How you can get started!**

**1) Take it for a spin!** Trellus is totally free for individuals to try out - they can get started in less than 5 seconds by downloading our chrome extension [here](https://app.trellus.ai/demo)

**2) Talk to us!** If you’re interested in trialing Trellus with your sales reps, [grab a quick time slot](https://calendly.com/ajinkya_nene/general-meeting) for a white-glove onboarding or let us know in the comments!

# Trellus adds an AI copilot for outbound sales to Salesloft, Outreach, Hubspot, Apollo, and others. 

### **Reps today face tool fatigue**

Sales reps today face tons of tool fatigue when doing their outbound work. It’s a constant balance of managing what’s the latest and greatest in AI with their core tech stack. At [Trellus](https://www.trellus.ai/), we took the view that reps should be able to still live in their existing tools while getting all the benefits of the newest advances in AI.

### **TRELLUS repurposes your existing sales stack with the latest ai tools**

Trellus uses a [Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/trellus/enhpjjojmnlnaokmppkkifgaonfojigl) (free to try out!) to inject AI assistance across your workflow - whether that be in researching a prospect, automating your dial work, or deciding what to write as part of your sales emails. By doing this, you can easily **2-3x** your output in your existing stack **without spending $$$$.**

**Get Custom AI Emails directly in your tech stack**

Trellus learns your company’s value prop, understands your prospects, and analyzes previous conversations, all in an effort to generate a personalized AI email that you can send off with one click.

![Trellus AI Copilot Walkthrough 🤖](https://www.tella.tv/api/stories/cm02hdd3t000603lc7fbh9htu/thumb.gif?version=2024-08-20T14:07:08.783Z&resolution=640x360&inpoint=105000)

It guides reps to exceed quota by identifying common situations in sales calls and delivering simple action-oriented suggestions at the moment they are needed. Trellus also completes all post-call work for reps including note-taking and call summarization._ [_Real-time AI is the future of sales support_](https://www.trellus.ai/post/real-time-ai-sales-coaching) _- check out our chrome extension today_ [_here_](https://app.trellus.ai/install-now)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68816&key=user_uploads/832328/639aa519-23ad-4c93-a11a-bdbcd74084f0)

# **The Problem**

**For sales reps** - it is hard to master all the skills necessary to have consistent and repeatable success in prospecting calls. A few examples of what reps need to stay on top of in each call:

1. Who the prospect is and how to build rapport
2. [What to respond to common cold call objections](https://www.trellus.ai/post/five-common-cold-call-objections)
3. Any qualification questions that need to be worked through - and the prospect's response
4. Their own delivery cadence - tempo, talk time, etc.
5. When to go for the close and book the next steps

**For managers** - it is hard to effectively supervise and train a team of reps since a team of reps has far more (combined) hours to make calls than a manager has time to review them. Existing sales intelligence tools like Gong / Chorus are commonly used for recording and review but offer limited help in coaching reps because [the analytics are less focused on prospecting calls and the feedback is often delayed.](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-coaching-is-broken)

# **The Solution**

Trellus solves these issues by giving your sales reps a real-time AI-powered sales coach that is available 24x7 to them. Trellus enables your reps to deliver the right message at the right moment to your prospects.

We do this by mixing a blend of behavioral and content coaching suggestions to help your sales reps learn best-in-class sales techniques.

* Seamless integration into your dialer platform of choice (it’s as simple as downloading our chrome extension)
* Behavioral coaching on monologues, cadence with a whole host of features coming soon (filler words, pauses, tone)
* Objection handling for classic cold call objections (e.g., “I’m not interested) with the ability for your sales enablement team to customize suggested responses for your reps
* Battle cards for competitors (e.g., “I use X”) - whenever one of your competitors is mentioned on a call, your rep will get suggested talking points
* Real-time transcription for all your dials
* Real-time localized data on your prospects (e.g., news, weather) to provide additional data sales reps can leverage to build repertoire
* Automatic call summarization and disposition entry

### **How you can get started!**

**2) Take it for a spin!** Trellus is totally free for individuals to try out - they can get started in less than 5 seconds by downloading our chrome extension [here](https://app.trellus.ai/demo)

**3) Talk to us!** If you’re interested in trialing Trellus with your sales reps, [grab a quick time slot](https://calendly.com/ajinkya_nene/general-meeting) for a white-glove onboarding or let us know in the comments!

launches.title: Demo Gorilla: Turn every demo into a sale

launches.body:
### Great demos sell your product

Great demos are magical, and yet we’ve all sat through mediocre sales demos that barely explain how the product works, forget the value props and go wildly off script – and that’s before you even try to ask a question!

Never again lose a SaaS deal because of a bad demo with [Demo Gorilla](https://demogorilla.com/?yclaunches).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64646&key=user_uploads/26230/a1d9bf4b-85aa-40e4-9159-4715eda27e21)

While you share one window with your prospects, you get a dynamic cheat sheet in another!

## What it does:

[Demo Gorilla](https://demogorilla.com/?yclaunches) is a browser extension that turns every member of your team into a brilliant demo-er.

As your team gives a demo, we automatically show the relevant talking points for **this specific prospect** and **this specfic feature** so your team is always selling the best value during their conversations.

We also:

* **Track what features are really demoed** so your product team knows what’s really happening in the field. Faster feedback means more efficient dev cycles.
* **Timestamp all actions** so you don’t need to watch the whole recording to revisit that aha moment.  Nobody wants to rewatch their entire sales call.
* **Inject collateral straight into demos** so you can show a single slide while you show the feature to keep the conversation on topic.  Nobody can remember the 30 slides you showed at the start of the call. Also works with videos & webpages if you’re fancy.
* **Sync with your Google calendar** so you don’t have to manually time check yourself. And you don’t forget who’s in the call!
* **Customized talk track per persona** so you’re talking about the value that matters to this customer against their current tool. Give them the data that’s relevant to them.
* Easily **give feedback for sales enablement** so the content stays applicable. Helps your enablement team help closers close.
* **Search talking points inline** so you never get stumped by a question. Now you don’t need to book a second meeting, you can close them today.

And it does all that seamlessly from whatever account you use to demo: a sandbox, a rep’s account or even the customer’s own data.

## Who it’s for:

Teams selling a SaaS tool, especially ones with great products facing the following challenges:

* Onboarding new account executives and sales engineers faster
* Founders looking to hand off sales to someone who hasn’t been living the product for years
* Struggling to hire enough sales engineers to support your AEs
* CSMs struggling to get renewals excited about expanding or upselling because they can’t show what’s new

## We’d love to hear from you!

Drop us a line at [hi@demogorilla.com](mailto:hi@demogorilla.com) and we’ll get you up and running better demos today!

launches.title: Vessel: Easily integrate with your customer’s CRM
launches.tagline: Vessel allows developers to read and write to their customer’s CRM with one integration.
launches.body:
### ⁉️ Problem

For products that need access to their customer’s CRM, having a breadth of integrations has become table-stakes. However, it is difficult to build CRM integrations in-house, because you need to:

* support different types of authentication
* understand the data model, APIs, and ever-changing specs of each CRM platform
* handle platform limitations like API quotas and limited webhooks support
* transform data from your customer’s CRM for use in your product

Companies are spending a lot of engineering resources building and maintaining CRM integrations in-house. For instance, we spoke to a company that built a HubSpot integration and had to turn it off because they didn’t have the resources to handle HubSpot’s API limits.

### 💡 Solution

Vessel is the universal API for CRMs, making it easy for developers to build applications that integrate with their customer’s CRM.

* A unified interface to read and write across 8 objects: Accounts, Leads, Contacts, Deals, Events, Notes, Tasks, [Users](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/603bd0ce2abb1-get-all-users)
* [Webhooks](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/e1m6clym4s5ya-webhooks) to keep your data fresh without polling even if the end platform does not offer webhooks on certain objects.
* A drop-in UI to securely connect your customer’s CRM to your product
* Avoidance of rate limits for platforms you integrate with
* Improved developer experience with strongly associated objects. You can easily identify all of the associated objects (e.g. going from leads -> accounts, accounts -> leads)

### ⚡ Get started

If you’re looking to integrate CRMs into your product, book some time [here](https://calendly.com/vesselapi/vessel-demo) or send us an email with your use case at [founders@vessel.land](mailto:founders@vessel.land)! Learn more at <https://vessel.land>.

launches.title: Kenobi - Personalize your website to every visitor
launches.tagline: Each web visitor is different. Let your site speak uniquely to each one.
launches.body:
Hi all, we are [Chris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrismjelde/) and [Rory](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rorz/), founders of [Kenobi](https://kenobi.ai).

**TL;DR:** _Kenobi is a small widget that asks your website visitors what company they’re from. For those that opt in, the whole page changes in about 3 seconds, making the page hyper-relevant to them._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/12072fa5-f903-4e42-88b2-5505250f9c5b)

### Problem

98% of web traffic does _not_ convert.

That’s because your website looks the same to everyone: a startup founder and the CFO of a Fortune 500 company get the exact same experience when they land on your site. When you have to speak to everyone, you end up speaking to no-one.

### Solution: Kenobi

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/a085a931-7365-4611-ac7e-e9f801324423)

Kenobi appears on your website as a small widget (we call it a ‘cue card’), prompting site visitors to share what company they’re from.

When a cue card is submitted, our agent collects context on the visitor, marries it up against the deep research its done on the host domain, and swaps the content on the page to make it hyper-personalized and unique, all in 2-3 seconds.

### The value

The value of Kenobi is two-fold:

1. Web visitors that opt-in for a personalized experience engage **3x longer** and convert **2x better** than the average visitor
2. All cue card submissions are sent to you in Slack (much like a deanonymization tool like RB2B, or Vector), so that you can enrich the leads and outbound them

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/3e972baa-67ec-40bb-9dbd-51044fa7a551)

### Demo video

https://www.loom.com/share/d3145c167cb84172a6dc242ef8e93109

### How we got here

We were building Verdn, a donation software, for 4+ years. We pivoted into building Kenobi in May, and for the last few months we’ve been working with sales teams to generate customized landing pages for outbound campaigns.

During all that time, our #1 feature request has been to cater for inbound web traffic. After tens of thousands of web page variations, we feel like our model is finally good and fast enough to tackle _inbound_ personalization.

### Try it

Go to [kenobi.ai/start](http://kenobi.ai/start) and see in 30 seconds how YOUR page can be personalized to any visitor. If you like how it looks, sign up for our free plan, no CC required.

launches.tagline: Build the perfect prospect list in <5 min with AI
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Ciro’s new Prospecting Autopilot uses AI to build the perfect prospect list — so you don’t have to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90130&key=user_uploads/503100/6de1c5c1-df62-43ec-8866-ae15b658be32)

After much tinkering, we built the sales tool we always wanted — an AI agent that can build your lead list for you.

### **Here’s how it works:**

* **First, Ciro scans your website** to learn about your Ideal Customer Profile and the products you sell
* **Then, it agentically tests multiple search strategies** (combinations of job titles, geography / headcount filters, industries, vector vs. keyword search over the universe of companies) to determine the best way to surface prospects within a universe of 500m+ profiles
* **Next, it performs the best-performing search**, reviews each profile, and scores them individually to ensure fit with your Ideal Customer Profile
* **Finally, it enriches contacts with verified emails & mobile numbers** from 15+ sources and dedupes/pushes relevant contacts to your CRM in one click

### **Why we built Autopilot**

* Founders & sales reps need a repeatable way to find decision-makers, without taking hours every day
* Contractors and virtual assistants cost $$ and can’t keep pace with shifting ICPs
* Users told us they wanted one button that _thinks_ through the search—and then just does it
* 👉 Our vision is friction-free prospecting from “Who should I target?” to “Meeting booked” — and we think Ciro Autopilot is a big step toward that future

### **Try it out**

* Create your account on [Ciro](https://ciro.io)
* Tell us in chat that you came from Launch YC — we’ll send you a bunch of bonus credits to get started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90130&key=user_uploads/503100/c93a8653-90e1-4d70-98c6-d98c6bafdb60)

launches.title: Ciro - 10x Your Prospecting on LinkedIn Sales Navigator
launches.tagline: Meet Ciro, your new Autopilot for sales prospecting on LinkedIn
launches.body:
**TL;DR** — LinkedIn has the best data for B2B sales but **zero automation**. Founders and sales reps waste TONS of time manually searching, qualifying, and engaging leads on the platform.

Ciro makes prospecting on LinkedIn 10x easier:

* **Ciro Autopilot** scans profiles (in Sales Navigator), qualifies them against your ideal customer profile, and builds a ready-to-contact list in minutes
* **Ciro Enrich** instantly reveals phone numbers and emails on profiles — whether you’re on a free or paid LinkedIn account (from our network of 13 high-quality data providers)

[Here’s a video](https://youtu.be/z0dYm46MfsM) of me using Ciro & watching Netflix with Ciro’s CEO, Richard.

### **The Problem:**

1. **A huge time commitment.** Sales reps (and Founders!) lose hours each week sifting through Sales Navigator searches, poking around profiles for the right fit
2. **Hard to filter out unqualified leads.** A great title alone doesn’t always mean they’re a great prospect — context matters, and double checking is a chore
3. **Zero contact info.** You’ll find the perfect lead, then pay for yet another tool just to get their email or phone
4. **Expensive integrations + data providers.** Connecting to LinkedIn so you can push to CRM? That’s $1600 annually, per seat. A license to Zoominfo? $10k a year. It adds up!

### **Why We Built Ciro**

Like many YC companies, Ciro’s customers operate on lean budgets but expect high quality output from their sales teams. The only way to bridge that gap is to arm them with great tools. We saw a few common problems:

* **Bottlenecks** **form** when companies rely on humans to parse information — revenue growth is gated on executing manual, repetitive tasks
* **Many products do too little** (simple browser extensions) or **require** **complicated orchestration** that takes forever to set up
* **Finding great contact data** is expensive and usually requires several additional subscriptions

### **Our Ask (Try It!) + How It Works**

_(for LinkedIn Sales Navigator subscribers)_

1. **Install** [**Ciro**](https://app.ciro.io/)
2. Edit the AI-generated Persona & Sales Navigator filters
3. Click Run! Watch the magic 🪄
4. Review contacts & enrich with emails + phone numbers
5. Push contacts directly to your CRM or download CSV

We’re excited to see how much you’ll accomplish with Ciro Autopilot at your side — and how many more deals you close!

### **What’s the Problem?**

If you run a business selling to an SMB vertical, you’ve probably found it **impossible to** **find rich data on the prospects in your market…** and that existing data solutions are rife with missing records, infrequent updates, and incorrect contact information.

### **What’s the Solution?**

Ciro handles prospect list building so you don’t have to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64232&key=user_uploads/928465/3ca9d271-95f9-45da-80ce-a085a8052544)

Our solution combines hundreds of vertical-specific web crawlers that run every day, plus a data ingestion engine that joins dozens of public and proprietary data sources. Through these tools we provide our customers with a complete prospect database, plus vertical-specific “signals” to focus their outreach.

Examples of these “signals” include:

* Changes to a prospect’s **tech stack** (e.g. a doctor’s office uninstalls ZocDoc)
* **New company formation** (e.g. a newly-registered construction license)
* **Ownership changes** (e.g. change-of-control updates to company reporting docs)

**TL;DR:** Truva is a Sales AI Agents platform that takes care of the tedious tasks—like email follow-ups and CRM data entry—so your team can focus on what truly matters: selling more.

Hi everyone, we’re [Anuja](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujaverma1/) and [Gaurav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gaurava91/) from Truva AI, and we’re thrilled to introduce [Truva](https://truva.ai) to sales teams everywhere!

Sales reps spend hours on manual tasks like CRM updates, lead enrichment, and follow-ups. This time-consuming admin work leads to missed opportunities, inconsistent data, and inaccurate forecasts. Not only does it frustrate sales teams, but it also stalls revenue growth.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85127&key=user_uploads/331716/987d62fa-4a6a-41db-b85b-95790f8a4b51)

**The Solution**_:_ Truva is a Sales AI agents platform that takes over the repetitive CRM tasks your team doesn’t want to handle. With Truva, you get an AI-driven platform that captures, organizes, and updates CRM data seamlessly. Covering everything from online meetings and emails to voice notes, Truva ensures every important detail is accounted for, letting you stay focused on selling. Here’s how Truva can transform your sales workflow:

Checkout Truva: <https://youtu.be/AtMIYPJOZ00>

* **Comprehensive Sales Activity Tracking-** Truva automatically tracks every interaction—from online meetings and in-person conversations to emails and voice memos—extracting key insights aligned with both custom and standard sales frameworks. It has your sales conversations covered, hassle-free.
* **Always-On CRM Updates-** Truva keeps your CRM structured, accurate, and up-to-date in real time. Say goodbye to manual data entry; instead, rely on an updated CRM you can trust.
* **AI-Powered Follow-Ups, Right on Time-** Truva identifies critical next steps and drafts personalized follow-up emails based on meeting details, ensuring no opportunity slips through. Follow-ups are timely, relevant, and automatic.
* **Advanced Sales Analytics & Insights-** Gain actionable insights: Truva analyzes prospect sentiment, engagement, and communication patterns, providing the data you need to refine your pitch and boost conversion rates.
* **Real-Time Alerts & Customizable Data Fields-** Stay on top of every conversation with real-time notifications, automated task creation, and customizable data mapping to the CRM fields that matter most.

**And this is just the beginning…**

**The Vision: A Sales Sidekick for Every Rep** 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️ Our long-term goal is for Truva to be the AI “Sidekick” to your sales “Superhero.” Acting as an orchestration layer across all your tools, Truva automates the busywork, so you can focus on closing deals and driving growth.

launches.title: 🚀 Openpod - Incentivize developer contributions and fundraise quickly for OSS projects
launches.tagline: We're helping open source projects launch better with DAO infrastructure and tokens
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Imagine if you had been able to buy Ubuntu tokens when it first launched…

**Openpod is a DAO-as-a-service platform for open-source projects to incentivize developer contribution and make fundraising easy**. Projects can use these governance/utility tokens to compensate developers for their work, let early investors/speculators purchase these tokens, and reward their community. 

**Check us out here:** \
[openpod.io](http://openpod.io)\
[app.openpod.io](http://app.openpod.io)

### **Problem:**

Launch ramps for open source projects are broken.

* It’s hard to get funding as a new or up-and-coming open source project, even if you have believers. Most of the available funds and donations are often taken by the top open source projects. 
* Maintaining consistent contributions from developers is tough since they are volunteering their time. They are also not compensated for work they did in the early phases of a project - even if it's a successful one.
* It’s tough to get people to use your product early on.

 

### **Our Solution:**

DAOs have long been a solution in search of a problem. **Open source projects are inherently decentralized and function as communities, which are hallmarks of DAOs.**

Openpod is a **DAO-as-a-service platform** for open source projects to establish their own DAO and mint utility tokens. Developers, users, and believers can purchase these tokens on our platform, and **get in early on potential growth** of the project and the token value. They’ll also be able to vote on new features and how the raised funding has been used. Meanwhile, the project can use this immediate funding for development. 

We’re adding Github integration with DAOs so that **when developers commit or push to a project’s repos, they’ll get automatically compensated** based on the bounties associated with their tasks. 

### **Backstory:**

As developers who have worked on open source projects previously, we’ve seen some of the best and brightest people get burnt out while doing work for little to no compensation - especially when these projects are new. So we feel it's only fair to **let developers have a way to earn returns on their hard effort** in the project.

### **Our Ask:**

We’d love to pilot the DAO creation platform with fellow YC companies! If you have a Github repository, and **a few cents to spare**, create your very own tokens for your project. 

**You could use these tokens to incentivize your early users, contributors, and have more people support you as a project.** 

We’re working on integrations to let token holders **redeem the tokens for Open Core/SaaS credits or other perks** **to ensure your tokens will have value**. Users could also sell their tokens to make returns. \
[openpod.io](http://openpod.io) \
[app.openpod.io](http://app.openpod.io)

launches.title: CustomerOS – Uncover hidden pipeline that actually converts
launches.tagline: The only B2B platform that tells you who to target, how to win, and what actually converts
launches.body:
Most top prospects never fill out forms, making them invisible until it’s too late. 

CustomerOS uses a team of AI-agents to identify and score leads based on their behavior, alerting sales with the right messaging at the right moment. It automatically builds your ideal customer profile, tracks buyer intent in real-time, and provides actionable insights for SDRs and decision makers.

https://youtu.be/Cru5GSrRfHQ

### The Team

We’re Matt & Jonty, the team that helped build Voxbone to a $519M exit and we’re now building the GTM platform we wish we’d had. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Seedcamp, Crane, and Cocoa.

### The Problem

**92% of your best leads don't fill out forms.**

They do deep research, and show real buying intent, but we never know who they are until it’s too late. By the time we realize they were interested, they’ve already signed with someone else who actually saw them coming.

Meanwhile your SDR drowns in unqualified “MQLs” that will never close.

CustomerOS solves this problem.

### Our Solution

CustomerOS surfaces high-fit leads that are actually evaluating your product in real-time. It scores buying stage and intent from their behavior and alerts sales with content and messaging to share at exactly the right moment to drive deals forward.

With CustomerOS you have a squadron of purpose-built AI agents, engineered to 

1. Outsmart your competition
2. Accelerate your pipeline
3. Turn every touchpoint into revenue firepower
4. Help SDRs focus on the leads that actually convert

### Here’s How it Works

### Your Ideal Customer Profile

CustomerOS automatically generates your ICP based on your website, content, and existing customers.  Then we score every lead  based on how well they fit your ICP.

Only high-fit leads make it into your pipeline so you don’t waste time on prospects who are never going to convert.  Everything on your screen is a qualified lead we actually WANT to close.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/0508be1e-076a-4b1a-87b6-073b8d7ed078)

### See Who's Ready to Buy

With our easy-to-setup web tracker, you can follow each lead's intent in real time. This allows you to know where they are in their journey and who’s ready to buy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/861fca57-630d-4eab-ab5b-f22ae5cbe953)

### Competitive Intelligence for SDRs

Each lead comes with tailored battle cards showing how big the opportunity can be, who else they’re likely evaluating, and what we need to do to win.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/bf890845-4aeb-4f3e-b770-d5ad51ae7287)

### Insights for Decision Makers

We automatically pull together insights from your lead behaviour, content engagement, and ad spend, and turn them into strategic recommendations that show decision-makers exactly where to double down and what to cut.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/51b3828a-21e3-43f1-a1d2-3e8993be5122)

### Our Ask

* Introduce us to a B2B VP of Marketing, or Head of SDR who would like to build a repeatable, high quality lead pipeline.
* Try the **Estimate my leads** tool and see how many ICP fit prospects are already evaluating you anonymously.
* Book a walkthrough.  Most customers book their first meeting in under a week.

 

**See who’s ready to buy right now at** [customeros.ai](http://customeros.ai)

### Proof

One of our early users put it simply:

> This thing prints meetings. We had two in the first two days, a third within the week, and more are lining up. The rest of the SDR team was fighting over access because the conversations were so easy and the close rate was so high.

Backed by **Y Combinator, Seedcamp, Crane, and Cocoa**, CustomerOS is built to solve the problems every GTM team faces.

### Why Now

The traditional lead generation infrastructure is crumbling due to privacy changes, AI cannibalization of search traffic, and the evolution of enterprise buyer behavior, making Pipeline Blindness a permanent competitive disadvantage. 

Early adopters are building intelligence moats through superior lead identification that get stronger with every qualified visitor.

The gap between companies with lead intelligence and those without is widening rapidly and becoming permanent - every day without this capability allows competitors to capture prospects you can't even see. 

Once the intelligence gap becomes permanent, no amount of marketing spend can close it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/3ae9386c-ab02-44b0-9d20-06cfa1f67dc5)

launches.title: Mocke, Cold Email AI Agent
launches.tagline: Cursor for cold email, with lead research and personalization at scale
launches.body:
Hey, it's Matt here. Really excited to launch Mocke today, because it has been a wow moment for ourselves and beta users. Can't wait to share it with everyone who writes cold email.

# TLDR;

Mocke is an AI agent for cold email. It works like Cursor for development. Mocke collapses hours of cold email writing into seconds and conducts deep research on each lead to deliver completely personalized messaging at scale.

Try Mocke here <https://mocke.co/>. No account is needed; just enter your website to see the cold email you are going to love in 60 seconds.

# **The problems we are solving**

### The 0.1 → 1 Problem

Even though everyone now has access to ChatGPT, crafting effective cold emails still requires significant time and effort. Here's the typical experience of someone writing cold emails:

1. ChatGPT provides a first draft in 5 seconds, which looks decent.
2. The user then spends time refining the phrases, CTA, subject line, messaging, and final touches. This process can take an hour or even several hours until they feel comfortable sending out the emails.

The challenge is rather the effort needed to refine the draft for production, because no one feels comfortable taking the 1st drafted email from ChatGPT and send to real leads. Therefore, I refer to this problem as the 0.1 to 1 problem.

### The personalization with deep research

ChatGPT is a commodity that everyone already has access to. So, writing a good cold email is no longer sufficient to get meaningful returns from campaigns. Relevance has already become the #1 indicator for a high reply rate. However, there are no effective tools available for conducting in-depth research on each lead and crafting personalized, unique emails for every individual.

In the market, many AI sales tools attempt to build rapport in cold emails by referencing LinkedIn activities, such as congratulating someone on a promotion or mentioning a recent post. However, leads can quickly recognize poorly generated personalization in these outreach efforts, which often lack genuine relevance. This undermines trust and reduces interest.

# **The solution - Mocke: your cold email AI agent**

Mocke is a Cold Email AI agent that functions like Cursor. It reduces hours of cold email writing and deep personalization to just 60 seconds, delivering thousands of unique email messages that leads will love instantly. While it works alongside you, the AI agent handles most of the ideation, writing, polishing, personalization, and deep research, allowing you to achieve results without lifting a finger.

### Step 1: Campaign idea

Mocke suggests campaign ideas. By simply entering your website, the AI agent identifies the ideal ICP, highlights the most suitable pain points for cold emailing (as not every pain point is effective for cold emailing), and provides a creative messaging angle designed to attract a lot of responses.

You can start not only with your website but also with your inbound website visitors, conference pre- and post-outreach, publishing a new case study, creating a new blog post, promoting a new AI feature, and more. Share any of these with Mocke, and the AI agent will develop a comprehensive outbound strategy for you.

Below is a basic example using [@Pylon](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/28069)’s website. (big fan of their product btw!)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/216b3b61-dd14-41ca-9838-5acb958e8d04)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/1595b949-d321-4eff-b84b-361df55b3934)

### Step 2: Email template

Mocke writes email templates with embedded prompts. Refer to the Pylon example below.

For each email, AI agent may propose an engaging subject line, a creative value-based call to action (beyond a simple meeting request), and crucially, instructions for conducting deep research and personalization, presented as prompts in **\[square brackets\]**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/dcad9216-12af-4494-ba86-d82f4cb52fee)

What Mocke will do is to run deep research into a lead, the business behind, their department and teams, and all relevant information with regard to what AI agent is selling. Then with the targeted deep research, AI agent will generate a highly-relevant email for one lead.

 Just to highlight, in the Pylon example above, there are various prompts:

* A paragraph prompt `[Write a short paragraph in 30 words or less. Ask the lead if their support team has experienced a large volume of support tickets in Q1 2026, and how they handle it. Must mention one specific technical product error message often asked by the lead's users. Must use deep technical terminology in the context of the lead's product. Must mention the lead's product name.]`
* A phrase prompt `[describe the lead's team, in 3 words or less]`

 So you can choose from full delegation to AI to write content, or partially if you want to have finer control over customization.

###  Step 3: Preview deep research and emails

To review the deep research and email writing, you can provide a lead's LinkedIn profile for the AI agent to conduct in-depth research and craft a personalized email in real-time. This ensures you feel confident about the dynamic content generated by the AI, based on the prompts embedded in the email templates.

 For this demo, I'm again using two potential leads of Pylon and have AI run deep research to write emails. You can compare them side-to-side to see the difference.

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/4d2f6ca8-bda6-4264-bab1-295e51ba50c4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/d773b48d-0501-4b35-83df-cb2364a6b508)

### Ready to launch

After completing the three steps in just 60 seconds, you can upload your list of leads. The AI agent will then conduct deep research and create personalized messages for each lead, one by one!

# 🚀🚀🚀 **Ask**

No sign-up is required, and it's free to use. Simply visit our website <https://mocke.co/> and enter your website. In just 60 seconds, you'll receive a cold email that you'll truly like.

My ask: try it out with your website and share your honest feedback. Let us know  whether you love it or not.

 

---

---

---

---

---

— — — —

---

# How it works underneath

If you are still reading and interested to know a little more.

### Email Writing Workflow

For each lead, Mocke would go through a few steps to write unique messaging per person and ensure it's relevant.

1. Build a profile of the lead by scraping LinkedIn page
2. Build a profile of the company of the lead by querying B2B databases
3. Use [@Firecrawl](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/27152) (shout out to the team, amazing product as well!) to crawl website and/or targeted information search using its agent
4. Use agentic loop to finish email writing, polishing, reviewing, scoring, and delivering

### What can be found in deep research?

1. Anything mentioned on main marketing website
2. Anything mentioned in documentation
3. Google searchable content if the results come back in the first page of SERP
4. Top reddit relevant threads (same reason as above, indexed by Google)
5. Personal and company LinkedIn profiles activities

### What if AI can't find information?

Mocke AI agent will not generate inaccurate information, as we have safeguards in place. In the case of information not found, AI will write generic content, rather than specific reference of information.

launches.title: Mocke - Mock cold email campaigns
launches.tagline: Know your reply rate in 1 min without launching
launches.body:
Hey, Matt and Daniel from Mocke (s22) here. We are beyond excited to launch a product that's never been seen before!

# TLDR;

Mocke AI agent mocks running cold email campaigns. Get campaign results in 1 min, such as spam, open, reply, or unsubscribe. Mocke also reveals why each lead didn't open emails, ignore, or forward. Unlock insights of campaign failure (or success!) not even seen in real life.

Completely free to start.

[Sign up here](https://mocke.co/)[ ](https://www.loom.com/share/3f83a2a5c8984bfe97a020843c29cb91)

# **The problem, that we take personally** 😕

At Mocke, we send a huge amount of cold emails (for our startup journey, see it in the end). Our daily cold email sending volume is up to 1,000,000 per day to the entire world. And we've seen a wild range of performance outcomes: the best around 80% open / 25% reply / 10% interest, and the worst would be zero interest or replies. Granted, cold email is hard because of all factors driving the results: deliverability, messaging, cta, brand awareness, competition, PMF, etc. At our scale, we've built possibly all the tools and AI to maximize the performance, except for one thing:

> _The messaging, or the message-market fit (MMF)_

On one day, we've seen a 10% interest rate for a given product, which easily generates 100 leads per day at our scale. The next day, we tried different messaging for the same product, just a minor tweak and prospect list, and got 0 replies. (Deliverability isn't our problem; our open rate never drops below 65% when we track it.)

 The problem is message-market fit. We cannot tell whether a message is going to resonate with this list of leads/personas/decision makers until we test it. We have to test it.

So here are the three core problems we are struggling with, and I'm sure you do as well:

* 💔 **SLOW - Cold email takes a long time to test**. Every campaign with a multi-step sequence takes 2 weeks to 1 month to test.
* 💔 **GUESSING GAME - Cold email gives no feedback**. If you have a 0% interest rate campaign sent to 1,000 people, why do people not respond? What's the problem? No one tells you, among those 1,000 people, why they don't care about your messaging. So you guess again and spend two weeks running another email copy.
* 💔 **WASTE** - **You are burning through real people, real customers.** You can't test too hard on these real customers, as it's going to harm your reputation.

This is a real challenge that everyone has to go through. There is no solution so far. Until today.

# **Meet Mocke**

Today, we are introducing Mocke, the _world's first and only_ AI agent that mocks cold email campaigns exactly like real campaigns. Here is how Mocke works:

1 - 📁 Upload your prepared campaign .csv file as usual to Mocke, 1-click to launch the (mocked) campaign

3 - 📈 You can view all replies, positive or negative, forward, unsubscribe, out of office, etc., like a real campaign

4 - 📊 Mocke **not only** reveals your predicted open rate, reply rate, interest rate, and unsubscribe rate, but you also get the following **critical** information:

1. 🚯 How many people clicked Report SPAM
2. 📨 How many people forwarded internally without letting you know
3. 🗑️ How many people ignore/archive/delete
4. 🤔 The leads' thoughts behind why people opened the email, why people read a 2nd time, why people reply, etc.

![](https://t18036112.p.clickup-attachments.com/t18036112/905bc8f8-a621-4fdc-b24f-28b943ed813e/3.png)

5 -💡 Based on visible campaign outcomes and hidden lead actions above, the AI agent analyzes the campaign to provide unseen insights in real campaigns instantly.

![](https://t18036112.p.clickup-attachments.com/t18036112/7be52197-6573-45e3-818b-3dced14bd3fc/4.png)

With Mocke, the game with cold email has forever changed.

* ❤️‍🔥 Instead of waiting for 2 weeks, **you get results in 1 min**
* ❤️‍🔥 Instead of a guessing game "why people didn't reply?", **you know the exact reasons**
* ❤️‍🔥 Instead of testing against real customers, **you test against them mocked, as many times as you wish**

Personally, I can't believe there is no such product in the world. We searched, but couldn't find any. So we made it for you, all of you looking at this comment now.

launches.body:
**tl;dr** [Pilot](https://www.getpilot.ai/) produces detailed notes and field updates that directly update the CRM after every sales call. For reps, this eliminates hours of admin work a week spent reviewing calls and updating the CRM (instead of selling). For sales leaders, this is the only way to ensure that high-quality data is produced and logged from every sales call.

Hi everyone, I’m Max - the founder of Pilot AI.

I’ve previously worked as a software engineer at Salesforce, built and scaled Tech & Product at Clipboard Health (W17), and then built out Revenue Operations at Welcome (S20), where it was my job to chase down sales reps every week to update Salesforce. Our reps could spend two hours a day going back through calls to take detailed notes and update the CRM - they all complained loudly about it, and they could have spent that time selling more.

Pilot frees up all of this wasted time through automation and makes it possible to maintain a clean CRM that can be used to produce accurate forecasts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65138&key=user_uploads/1028295/b95d6aca-12e8-4c0f-b641-c01c8d281c49)

## **What’s the problem?**

Salespeople can spend 25% of their day writing up notes and updating the CRM, which they could spend generating more revenue. Every salesperson despises this part so much that frequently, they just don’t do it. This causes numerous problems including making deals difficult to review, handoffs impossible and forecasting inaccurate.

## **The Solution?**

**Stop relying on salespeople to take notes and update the CRM**.

Pilot is an AI assistant that generates detailed notes and structured data that call that updates the CRM for every call. The notes are easy to read and don’t include the rambling, small talk and pauses of the conversation but instead capture the most important points. 

Form every conversation, Pilot produces:

1. A scannable summary
2. Datapoints that map to CRM fields
3. Every question asked by the rep and the most important parts of the prospect's answer
4. Additional essential points that the prospect made during the call

If you’re facing this problem in your organization - we’d love to show you our magic trick. [Schedule a demo!](https://calendly.com/max-pilot-ai/30min)

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Create your dream GTM motion at the speed of thought. Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence. Avina finds matching companies 24/7, enriches them with verified contacts, writes personalized sequences tied to the exact signal, and syncs leads wherever your team works. Signal to AI outbound, fully automated. Starting at $149/mo.

👋 Hey friends, we're Vivek and Mike (YC S22). We previously built and sold Bowtie to Mindbody, and now we're building Avina to fix outbound.

<https://youtu.be/rdUnYD9Z6Ac>

**The problem**

Generic outbound is dying, but doing smart outbound is still painfully hard.

The pitches that get replies are the ones that arrive right when something happening at the prospect's company makes your product feel relevant. The hard part has always been finding those moments at scale and acting on them fast.

**Our solution**

Avina finds the companies that actually need your product right now, qualifies them, and automatically engages them with personalized AI outreach. All synced with your existing sales stack.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/d34b49d3-f41b-4940-83da-11472e593ba8)

**How it works**

Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence:

* _Selling usage-based billing?_ "PLG companies that just launched an API in the last 3 months"
* _Selling compliance automation?_ "Companies awarded a prime DoD contract in the last 30 days"
* _Selling cybersecurity?_ "Healthcare companies that experienced a data breach in the last 6 months"
* _Selling voice AI?_ "Mid-market home services companies with recent negative reviews mentioning 'long wait times' or 'understaffed'"

It works for first-party intent too. Website visitor de-anonymization is built in (RB2B, Vector, and more), so you can act on inbound signals like "prospects that visited our pricing page for more than 2 min.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/601dc08e-720f-4466-9deb-433c0902d7df)

Avina takes it from there. Four agents handle the full pipeline:

1. **Signals Agent** monitors the web 24/7 for matching companies: press releases, job posts, LinkedIn posts, technographics, inbound site visitors, and more
2. **Qualification Agent** scores leads against your ICP, finds your target contact at the company, and enriches them with verified contact details.
3. **Outbound Agent** researches each company, writes personalized emails tied to the specific trigger, and sends via your existing sequencer (Instantly, HubSpot, Lemlist, Smartlead) so you keep your warmed domains
4. **Workflow Agent** syncs every lead to the rest of your stack: CRM lists, Slack, Clay, Zapier, and more

**Try it free!**

Start a 14-day free trial at [avina.io](http://avina.io).

Not sure what signals to start with? Our in-product **Signal Recommender** analyzes your website and suggests high-impact buying triggers, and we have a[ library of 250+ examples for inspiration](https://avina.io/signals-library).

Hi YC!

Fil and Eddie here - we’re co-founders at [rift](http://getrift.com) (W23). We met while working on the growth team at Pulley (W20). At Pulley, we learned that setting up your cold outbound email channel is really hard, rift is our attempt at making it easier!

### ❌ **The problem**

You’re a B2B business, and you’ve been sending sales emails to your prospective customers. Here are some of your stats:

* You’re sending **100+ emails/day.**
* Open rates are below **50%.**
* Reply rates are around **1%**.
* Bounce rates are upwards of **\~5%**.

If you don’t change anything, your next campaign will likely perform worse. Over time, open and reply rates will drop, and your bounce rate will go up.

Eventually, your domain reputation will be low enough that you won’t be able to contact your leads or existing customers. This is a tough situation to get out of, and it might take months to recover your domain reputation.

### 🎉 **The solution**

You need to do two things to effectively sell over email:

1. Set up your cold email infrastructure correctly.
2. Send relevant sales emails to the right people.

**rift does it all for you in a single platform**. You don’t need to be an expert in email deliverability or cold outbound.

Our product implements the email infrastructure for you, so you can focus only on growing your business. We will work with you 1:1 on writing sales emails that actually get replies.
