launches.tagline: Sign up and Bluebirds will automatically identify champions using Machine Learning, detect job changes, and deliver hundreds of warm leads ranked by your ICP. Oh, and it's free.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

* **What:** Bluebirds helps outbound teams resell to past customers who have switched jobs. Past customers are **4x more likely to convert to Closed / Won deals** with **much faster sales cycles.** It’s low hanging fruit and flies under the radar because of stale CRM data and workflow limitations.
* **How:** Any sales rep, manager, or rev ops can sign up on [www.bluebirds.com](http://www.bluebirds.com) and Bluebirds will automatically identify champions using Machine Learning, detect job changes, and deliver hundreds of warm leads ranked by your ICP.
* **Traction:** Revenue teams at scale-ups like Front, OneSignal, and a dozen more use Bluebirds to track their customer job changes and maximize outbound efficiency.
* **Ask: Sign up, or refer any sales teams, and we’ll deliver 100 free warm leads.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69546&key=user_uploads/987806/859fa27a-5373-4527-8d37-2fe95c918ec1)

### **Problem and why existing solutions don’t work**

Outbound sales isn’t working like it used to. **Conversions rates have tanked** because every sales team is using the same tech stack to spam buyer inboxes, and sales leaders are under pressure from their CEOs and Boards to grow efficiently. But most of the **outbound sales process is not efficient at all.**

Luckily there’s one sales play that works exceptionally well – reselling to your past customers who already trust your company and switched jobs. These leads, AKA _“blue birds”_, are your sales teams’ favorite. They’re layups, but also painfully difficult to track at scale.

**Existing solutions like LinkedIn Sales Navigator aren’t deeply connected to your CRM**. They don’t know who your customers are or what your ICP is, and rely on **manual / brittle filters** **that break** once you have over \~100 customers. The result is that most of your reps just aren’t tracking customer job changes.

Yet 10% to 20% of your CRM contacts have already switched jobs, and 1 to 2% switch every month.

This 👏 Is 👏 ARR 👏 Left 👏 On 👏 The 👏 Table 👏

### **How Bluebirds works**

What used to take reps hours to hack in Sales Navigator now happens automatically with 2 clicks and runs continuously in the background. Oh, and it’s free to get started. Here’s how:

* **Sign Up:** Anyone (Founders, VPs, Managers, AEs, SDRs, Sales Ops, etc.) can [sign up on our website](https://bluebirds.com) and log in via SFDC secure authentication.
* **Find Champions:** Our algorithms will find which contacts in your CRM are likely to buy your product again.
* **Match Identities:** We’ll match your sparse contacts to public identities (i.e. john@hotmail is John Smith at Airtable) and check if they’ve switched jobs.
* **Deliver Leads:** Finally we’ll rank all the leads based on similarity to your ICP and send them to you, along with monthly updates with any fresh job changes.

### **Why us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69546&key=user_uploads/987806/ab789d18-71a3-4cc5-a5bf-38e4cea98af4)

[Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kpunera/) and [I](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohanpunamia/) are well-versed with contact data and building AI systems to solve sales problems. I used to work in Sales Operations and Product at LinkedIn. Kunal was an AI Director at LinkedIn & Google, founding AI engineer at RelateIQ (sold to Salesforce), and earned his PhD in Machine Learning.

### **How you can help**

* **Intros to sales managers and leaders** at companies with at least a few hundred customers (usually Series B onwards). For sales orgs that fit what we’re looking for, we’ll offer free leads a no-brainer deal (seriously).
* [**Share our website**](http://bluebirds.com) **with sales reps or relevant communities** and ask them to sign up! We’ll hook them up with leads to hit their quota.

If you have any questions or can make intros, my email is [rohan@bluebirds.ai](mailto:rohan@bluebirds.ai)

launches.title: Floworks AI SDR: Alisha v2
launches.tagline: Alisha v2 automates the entire outbound sales workflow —lead research, sequencing, objection handling, followups.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**\
In the v2 of [Floworks](https://floworks.ai/) AI SDR,

1. **High Precision Lead Research:** Alisha AI SDR performs hyper-focused research on prospects by connecting with 10+ sales databases and finding intent signals across 20+ sources.
2. **Run sequencing across email and LinkedIn _simultaneously_**: Reach, engage, sequence your prospects over both email and linkedin.
3. **Automated objection handling:** Objection/question/query- our AI SDR handles all responses. Every response is grounded in your business data.
4. **Automate meeting scheduling:** Our AI SDR, being linked with your calendar, can coordinate on your behalf to book meetings fully _autonomously_.
5. **Two way CRM Sync:** Alisha AI SDR keeps your CRM updated with every outreach sequencing data. It also runs new campaigns automatically based on the deal progression.

To get started with Alisha AI SDR, book an intro call with us [here](https://calendly.com/alisha-2ome/30min?embed_domain=floworks.ai&embed_type=Inline&hide_landing_page_details=1&hide_gdpr_banner=1&text_color=000000&primary_color=9209f3&back=1&month=2024-11). We are offering 10% additional discount (with annual plans) on the [listed price](https://floworks.ai/pricing) for customers coming through YC listing.

### **High Precision 🎯 Lead Research**

Alisha AI SDR goes beyond traditional spray and paint approach. With a ChatGPT like interface, you can instruct Alisha to find and pinpoint the exact lead persona.\\

* “Find me VP of Sales at UK based healthcare SaaS companies that have recently entered a deal with NHS”
* “Find me VP of Sales of Fintech companies that recently got Federal Reserve licenses” 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/d26f8751-b536-46c7-85d1-1f72a3d9888f)

### **Multi Channel (Email+Linkedin) Sequencing**

The "Media Synergy" principle says that advertising impact is enhanced when consumers encounter messaging across multiple touchpoints, as each channel reinforces and complements the others.

Yes! That quite literally is this feature.

If your prospect does not respond to emails, Alisha reaches out over Linkedin. If your prospect asks for contracts, Alisha switches back to email again- all while maintaining the context of the conversations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/9abc5fa8-287e-46e4-a210-b7ccefbf0d62)

_Prospect: Ujjwal, while Aishwarya is communicating through our AI SDR product Alisha_

### **Instant ⚡ Objection Handling with Grounded AI response**

How many times have we seen leads dying off because we couldn’t reply to them in time. _A recent HBS study says any response after 15 min of receiving a query reduces the chances of conversion by 80%._ Hence, we introduce Instant Objection Handling.

_Here’s how it works:_

While setting up the sequence, you provide AI SDR (a.k.a. Alisha) with all and any of your product/sales info. Supported format of files includes **PDF, Websites, CSV, Plain text, Docs.**

Now, lets say your prospect asks a question “How much does your pricing look like?”, “Can you share some case studies relevant to our industry”. Our AI looks into all the documents and provides an answer. In case it does not find the answer, it does not hallucinate, instead alerts the user.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/020e1df3-1465-414d-8cc0-dd5f1d10be3e)

> We ensure our model doesn't hallucinate and always provides grounded answers by using our proprietary function calling engine, Thor v2. Read More about this on our [Arxiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17950v1)

### **Calendar Coordination without Calendly**

Sending over Calendly links and asking your prospect to book is never considered a sales best practice. First of all, it shifts the burden of work to the prospect (they have to click through, check your availability, and book). And naturally many people won't take the effort, so conversion suffers.\
\
Plus, in many cultures and settings, it's actually considered rude. It's like saying "have your people call my people". \
\
So here we come. Alisha AI SDR is integrated with your calendar and goes on to suggest vacant slots to the prospects. Based on the response of the prospect, Alisha AI SDR coordinates like a human and books a meeting accordingly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/00fe4265-117c-432e-afcc-f53826036dae)

_Prospect: Ujjwal, while Aishwarya is communicating through our AI SDR product Alisha_\
\
**Further** **Improvements on v1**

### **Even more control in Composing Messages**

We found out that AI is not really great at composing Sales emails. However, it is great at collating information from multiple sources and plugging them appropriately in a specific format.

So, we decided to give the control back to the user. Instead of having Alisha AI SDR write up email from scratch, we provide multiple “recipes” (a.k.a. collection of best cold email formats). Alisha can start from a template and then create personalised copies based on the profiles of each lead.

Alisha can now plug in inline images, links seamlessly in the email body.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/64ccb343-eb07-4751-b5ca-bd135cf6bab3)

**To get started, book an intro call with us **[**here**](https://calendly.com/alisha-2ome/30min?embed_domain=floworks.ai&embed_type=Inline&hide_landing_page_details=1&hide_gdpr_banner=1&text_color=000000&primary_color=9209f3&back=1&month=2024-11)**.**

launches.body:
**tl;dr**: [Echo](https://www.echothat.ai/) helps B2B founders excel at sales calls by building and consistently executing their sales playbooks. We use a fine-tuned language model to automate the process founders undergo with sales coaches, assisting them in adopting and maintaining best practices. [If you need help with this, let's talk.](https://usemotion.com/meet/tal-feld/intro)

—

Hey everyone, we’re [Tal](https://linkedin.com/in/tal-feld), [Noam](https://linkedin.com/in/noam-hertz), and [Ido](https://linkedin.com/in/ido-fish-62577b102). We've been friends for over 15 years, built products together for the past four years, and are on a mission to help B2B founders get better at sales.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83680&key=user_uploads/834401/08186ad5-8ddc-4cb7-a08e-b8370a4a969a)

# **How we got here**

Over the past two years, we've conducted hundreds of B2B discovery and sales calls. After repeatedly failing to qualify prospects and close paying customers, we realized we had to change our approach to sales. We read sales books, listened to podcasts, and consulted with sales coaches. What ultimately worked for us was the sales coaches' playbooks for each step in the sales process, and it worked like a charm. We finally had a structured process and knew what to say at each point. We started quickly disqualifying prospects and, most importantly, started closing paid customers repeatedly. Going through this process ourselves made us realize it could and should be automated without paying a sales coach $2-3k/hour. So that's what we're doing.

# **The Problem: Founder-led sales are unstructured**

Founders often conduct sales calls without a clear plan and fail to follow best practices, resulting in missed opportunities. In particular, they fail to:

* Qualify prospects and eliminate window shoppers.
* Convince prospects to give their product a chance.
* Prove they can deliver value in a short period.
* Monetize their value and grow their revenue.
* Determine why a deal was won or lost.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83680&key=user_uploads/834401/712831f0-0419-4d9b-9307-b575a163a532)

This means an unclear path for improvement and a lack of understanding of what needs to change to increase revenue consistently.

Founders who attempt to resolve this issue by delegating to a salesperson spend significant money and time only to realize that this approach does not work.

# **The Solution: Personalized playbooks with a close feedback loop**

Echo helps early-stage startups improve qualification, shorten sale cycles, and increase close rates in a repeatable way by building and consistently executing their sales playbooks.

Each playbook is a guide that covers questions to ask, information to share, and decisions to make during each discovery, demo, POC scoping, and closing call.

**How it works**

Echo will coach you similarly to how human sales coaches work with clients but in an automated way.

1. You fill in a brief about your company.
2. Echo will generate a custom playbook for each step.
3. You record your calls and share them with us.
4. Echo will generate feedback on execution and how to improve.
5. Playbooks are updated based on new insights from your calls.

# **Ask**

* Share and upvote this post. It would help us a lot.
* If you are a founder at a B2B startup looking to improve your sales, [book an intro call](https://usemotion.com/meet/tal-feld/intro).
* If you have worked with a sales coach and are willing to share your experience, we would love to [chat with you](https://usemotion.com/meet/tal-feld/short-chat).
* If you hear other founders complain about their sales, please direct them to our [website](https://www.echothat.ai/) or introduce us at [tal@echothat.ai](mailto:tal@echothat.ai).

name: Coldreach

launches.title: Hindsight – Competitive Intelligence That’s Actually Intelligent
launches.tagline: Win more competitive deals with simple AI-powered insights and workflows
launches.body:
Deals are more competitive than ever, and sales teams don’t feel prepared to win. Product marketing teams constantly get hit with questions like:

* “How do we beat \[competitor\]?”
* “Do we have a battlecard for this?”
* “What’s our answer to \[new competitor launch\]?”

To find answers, teams have to dig through call recordings, piece together competitor research, and hope they’re making the right call.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88481&key=user_uploads/1213493/b87ca67c-de33-4a14-9dfa-28abc23ce023)

### **The Problem**

Competitive intelligence today is **broken**:

* **Prioritizing junk data** – Teams spend tons of money on web monitoring tools that flood them with alerts that don't actually matter.
* **Ignoring the best source of intelligence—actual buyers** – Most marketing teams review **<5%** of calls and talk to **<1%** of lost prospects. That’s not enough to know why deals are really won or lost.
* **Outdated content** – PMMs spend weeks building battlecards that go stale before they’re used. Sales stops trusting them, and adoption plummets.

### **How Hindsight Fixes This**

<https://youtu.be/vqNqL9ZylVU>

Unlike other CI tools, Hindsight prioritizes competitive insights directly from your buyers AND helps you collect it.

* **Win-Loss at Scale** – AI analyzes 100% of your CRM deals, calls, and emails to uncover decision drivers, identify competitors, and clip key quotes from deals.
* **Automated Buyer Feedback** – Hindsight runs unbiased debriefs with won and lost prospects to uncover how they really compare you vs. competitors—giving you the data sales teams actually need.
* **Real-Time Competitive Intelligence** – Hindsight monitors the web and your other sales tools daily to build and maintain battlecards automatically.
* **Just-in-Time Sales Enablement** – Insights and battlecards are delivered directly in Slack or email so reps always have the right info before their calls. Automatically updated as new insights roll in.
* And a lot more!

### **Why We’re Building Hindsight**

Hey, I’m Ani 👋. I co-founded Hindsight with one of my best friends, Andrew Luo. When I was a PM, I spent too much time **guessing** why we won or lost deals. Our roadmap was shaped by opinions instead of facts, and I struggled to get sales teams aligned with the right messaging.

We built Hindsight to turn every deal into a learning opportunity and make sure sales, product, and marketing are always aligned on the truth.

### **See Hindsight in Action**

Hindsight integrates seamlessly with **Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack and other popular tools**, so you can capture and act on the right insights instantly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88481&key=user_uploads/1213493/be5da5a9-7e57-46d3-b273-13557e270c68)

Teams using Hindsight see competitive win rates increase by up to **15%**.

If you’re in a competitive industry and want to stop losing winnable deals

**→** [**Get early access**](https://www.usehindsight.com/)

launches.title: Gerri 2.0 - The AI Agent for Contracts from Common Paper
launches.tagline: Put your redlines on autopilot
launches.body:
Most AI contract tools are built to support a single lawyer working within Word. [Gerri is built for everyone with a stake in getting a deal signed.](https://www.getgerri.ai/) 

2 minute intro:[ youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY) 

3 minute demo:[ loom.com/share/ac7906243ce340159797af888488cb6b](https://www.loom.com/share/ac7906243ce340159797af888488cb6b)

**Background:**

More than 10,000 companies have used Common Paper to close deals over the past few years. While the standards have helped, we keep hearing how painful the redline process is. The root cause is that contract negotiation is a team sport, but most tools are built for one player.

Most teams end up in one of two camps:

* Every redline goes to the attorney, which is expensive and slows deals down
* Redlines get triaged first, usually by someone in sales or ops, and contracts are one of 10 things they have on their plate

What's missing is a system where AI does the first read, loops in the right people when needed, and pulls all of their feedback into a new draft that can be sent back to the other side. 

That's Gerri.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99518&key=user_uploads/71220/c7e0519b-5c7b-46d2-8456-3ecbb0a4b5b4)


**How it works:**

Contracts get into Gerri three ways: upload, forwarded email, or direct inbox scanning. From there:

* Gerri reads every redline against your playbook and automatically accepts, rejects, or counterproposes anything it can handle
* Anything outside the playbook gets routed to the right person. That might be legal for indemnity questions, finance for payment terms, VP of Sales for commercial terms, etc.
* Every AI decision cites the specific playbook rule behind it; every human override is logged
* Gerri edits the Word doc directly and can add comments in your name, explaining the reasoning to the other side

Gerri typically reviews contracts before you even know they've arrived. You'll open your inbox, see a contract, and find it's already been handled.

**What's new in 2.0:**

* 10X faster processing engine. 90% of contracts reviewed in under 3 minutes.
* Any contract type: your paper, their paper, standard or custom agreements
* Personality Settings: set custom instructions that guide Gerri's behavior across all contracts, without editing individual playbook rules
* Template Improvement: Gerri analyzes your negotiation history and suggests changes to your outgoing templates that proactively reduce future redlines. The more you use it, the smarter your paper gets.
* Optional attorney review add-on: flat fee, 4-hour turnaround guarantee, for when you need a human in the loop
* Available as a standalone product at [getgerri.ai](http://getgerri.ai)  - No other Common Paper subscription required

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99518&key=user_uploads/71220/304536b5-ce30-400e-8036-e43eb4c63ce3)

Try it free at [getgerri.ai](http://getgerri.ai)

launches.title: Gerri - The AI Agent for Contract Redlines
launches.tagline: Get your contracts reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox
launches.body:
We’re Jake and Ben, co-founders of Common Paper.  We just launched Gerri, the AI agent for redlines. [Try it out here and get three contracts reviewed for free](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL4nIETkZnY

## Problem

Common Paper started by creating [standard agreements](https://commonpaper.com/standards/) that have been signed by more than 10,000 companies and used to close more than $100 million dollars in deals. We also make contract management software for customizing, signing, and tracking agreements with customers and partners.

As companies scale, more and more of their sales teams’ time is spent dealing with contract redlines from their customers.  After talking seeing the problem close up at countless companies, we found that most folks fall into one of two camps:

* Every contract redline gets sent to their attorney, which is expensive and adds delays
* Nothing gets sent to the attorney, and the founder, sales, ops, or other non-lawyer handles all redlines. This creates a significant risk when they don’t know what they don’t know about risks in contracts

A better approach is to have AI do a first read of each contract and then triage the redlines so that as much as possible is handled automatically, and then if anything remains, assign it to the right person. That’s what we built with Gerri.

## Solution

There are three ways contracts get into Gerri:

* Upload
* Forward an email with attachment
* Have Gerri scan your team’s inboxes for redlined contracts and automatically review them as they come in

Once Gerri gets a contract, it compares it to your playbook, which contains rules about what you will and won’t accept, how you respond to asks, comments to leave in the doc, etc. Gerri includes a demo playbook to help you get started, and you can chat or answer questions to have Gerri help you generate your own custom rules.

Gerri then either

* Responds with a clean contract that’s ready to send back to the other side.  Gerri automatically accepts, rejects, counter-proposes, and leaves comments for the other side.  
* Flags which redlines can’t be handled automatically, and notifies the right people for them to weigh in. For example, it might be your lawyer for indemnity issues, CS lead for renewal terms, and IT for special security procedures/certifications.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/c61e5a05-75a4-4f95-a66d-cf4f618bb057)

Each time a human weighs in, they can make a decision for just this one case or have Gerri generate a rule to handle this decision going forward. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94771&key=user_uploads/71220/a1877eb9-5798-4ba5-8b31-eac429cd02b1)

The end result is your contracts get reviewed before you even realize they’re in your inbox, and deals close faster.

[Check out Gerri and get three contracts reviewed for free. ](https://commonpaper.com/product/ai-agent)

launches.tagline: Common Paper helps startups close deals with their customers faster and with less risk.
launches.body:
TLDR: If you want to close deals faster/shorten your sales cycles with standardized contracts and a platform that helps eliminate back and forth, [we’d love for you to try us out](https://commonpaper.com/)!

# Background

We (Jake and Ben) met while working together at a BI startup called RJMetrics. Jake was a co-founder, and Ben was an engineering leader. At that job and others, we were incredibly **frustrated by contract negotiation**. The process was filled with:

* **⏳ Unpredictable delays**
* **💰 Huge legal bills**
* **🥽 Extremely limited visibility**

We realized that founders and go-to-market teams have many of the same problems with sales that were widespread in startup fundraising before the introduction of the SAFE. Each company has a unique sales or procurement contract (and NDA, DPA, etc).  People argue over whose template to use, and **no matter who wins that argument, one side of the deal has to review and negotiate a new contract for the first time**.

The same basic ideas show up in all contracts about a given type of transaction, but they are expressed totally differently.  As an example, take governing law, one of the simplest terms in most contracts.  These are real examples from four contracts, showing four different ways describe governing law:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68207&key=user_uploads/71220/b869c8db-5099-478e-855d-b34c5b28bf55)

# Standard Contracts & Structured Data

To solve this, we looked to the SAFE and other widely used contracts for inspiration and created standard, open-source contracts for buying and selling software, including:

* [Design Partner Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/design-partner-agreement/)
* [Mutual NDA](https://commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/)
* [Terms of Service](https://commonpaper.com/standards/terms-of-service/)
* [Cloud Service Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/cloud-service-agreement/) 
* [Data Processing Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/data-processing-agreement/), [Service Level Agreement](https://commonpaper.com/standards/service-level-agreement/), and more

These contracts have been downloaded by thousands of companies, are created by a committee of attorneys, and are free to use under a Creative Commons license. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68207&key=user_uploads/71220/bc9fd4c5-56c8-48ed-8ab2-dd024fa5b974)

Using standard contracts reduces back and forth, accelerates sales cycles, and makes it easier for everyone involved to understand what the contracts actually mean.

In addition to the contracts themselves, we’ve built a new kind of [contract management platform](https://commonpaper.com/product/) for startups.  It makes automation, negotiation, and programmatic access to contract data all way faster and easier than ever before. These kinds of tools have traditionally been built for managing unstructured text, and we’ve built Common Paper on top of the **standards and structured data**. 

**⌚ 63% of the deals on our platform close within 24 hours ⏲️**

We also built the [SaaS Agreement Toolkit](https://commonpaper.com/resources/saas-agreement-toolkit), which combines the standard agreements with step by step guides to help founders:

* Choose which contracts to use based on their stage and business model
* Understand the meaning of different terms within the contracts

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/5a0ce469-00e7-416a-8af0-ba3a7b9f0718)

### Problem

Revenue-facing teams in B2B companies run all their operations on customer data, whether it is managing an advertising budget, launching integrated campaigns, closing deals, or retaining customers. But there is no central system of record for customer data that they can use to run their operations, so instead, they rely on tens of different data tools and spreadsheets.

The CRM was built for this purpose, but over 20 years it got outdated, and companies found themselves either having to find hacks to format their data to fit the CRM, or build a data warehouse from scratch.

### Solution

HockeyStack collects all data about customer interactions through a web analytics script, a set of integrations to revenue-related business systems (CRM, ads, marketing automation, email, etc.), and data partners.

Any non-technical person in a B2B company can use HockeyStack’s reporting interface to answer complex questions like:

* What marketing channel had the best unit economics this quarter?
* Which segment of companies do we have the highest account penetration in?
* What makes a customer buy our software faster?
* Who are the highest intent companies who have not yet booked a demo with us?

They click into the numbers, and can see a list of accounts behind the report, all of which have their entire history of engagement with the company displayed alongside important firmographics.

This information can be used to create and export lists of high-intent accounts based on different segmentations out to various marketing and sales platforms to start or accelerate the sales conversation.

launches.tagline: Global and EU compliant outreach. Run targeted email, LinkedIn and letter campaigns.
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We are Lucas and Stefan from Venta AI. A year ago we launched an outreach tool for Europe and soon had to learn about EU-compliance laws. Since cold mailing is not legal in most of Europe, we implemented LinkedIn and letters as alternative and highly effective outreach channels. Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0 -compliant AI SDR that can run multi-channel outreach campaigns to highly targeted prospects globally.

**TL;DR:** Venta AI is a legally compliant AI SDR that automates prospecting and cold outreach via letters, LinkedIn and email. Thanks to our AI-based qualification and multi-channel approach you can reach every customer, avoid landing in SPAM and increase your reply rates at least 2x.

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0\*\*)

**Meet Europe’s strict regulations on cold outreach**

When we started cold outreach, compliance wasn’t top of mind. We knew that many EU countries have restrictions and informed our users about them. But soon enough one user received a cease and desist letter for sending a cold email and had to pay a hefty fine. This incident prompted us to take a closer look. EU regulations generally forbid sending electronic messages without an explicit opt-in. In many cases, enforcement might be lax, but if you run afoul of these laws, you could face everything from a cease and desist letter (with fines in the hundreds) to a lawsuit (potential fines of up to hundreds of thousands) or even a severe GDPR violation, which can result in penalties reaching millions.

If you think this is solely a European issue, you might also want to check out Canada’s anti-spam legislation (CASL) or Australia’s Spam Act.

**Email deliverability is a nightmare**

The second problem everyone faces with cold mailing is email deliverability. People have written enough about this on Bookface, so I will just say: it becomes a never ending cat and mouse game between cold mailers and email service providers (mainly Gmail and especially Outlook).

**Compliant ways to reach out**

If you don't want to break any laws in the above countries, you have 3 options for cold outreach:

* LinkedIn messages (allowed if connection request accepted)
* Phone calls (allowed with "presumed consent")
* Sending letters (always allowed)

Since LinkedIn limits how much you can send and phone calls take a lot of time, there is only one truly compliant and infinitely scalable way to cold outreach: letters.

**Launching Venta AI 2.0 - compliant outreach at scale**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88760&key=user_uploads/1367242/8ae24024-3a29-4a24-8ab4-2cfefb753cc7)

Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0, which allows you to run multi-channel outreach via email, LinkedIn and letters, while remaining compliant in each country.

Since letters need to be printed and postage paid, we help you use this channel as cost-efficiently and effectively as possible:

1. **Qualification**: Venta AI qualifies accounts based on your own questions, such as: "Is this a logistics company that uses electric trucks". This helps to ensure that you are only contacting your ICPs.
2. **Contact Picking**: Letters should only be sent to 1-2 people in a company. Venta AI always selects the most appropriate contact from all employees in a company based on your buying personas.
3. **The correct postal address:** As described [here](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/posts/86152), we have learned the hard way that many business addresses in company databases are just plain wrong. So we scrape the addresses directly from a company's website, select the location closest to our prospect and validate the address before sending.
4. **CTAs & Traceability:** Letters work differently than emails. To bridge the gap from analog to digital, we always include personalized QR codes on every letter. You get an instant Slack notification with the contact's number when they scan it.
5. **Saving money on sending**: You can send worldwide directly from our platform and simply pay with credits in your subscription.

**What to expect from letters**

We ran several campaigns testing letters directly against email, sending the same message to the same ICP (CEOs in marketing agencies). Email campaigns were run with fully warmed up Gmail accounts, optimized sending times and AI spintax. Letter campaigns were printed with a handwritten font.

On average across 1200 contacts we saw a **2x improvement** in reply rate (4.5% from letters vs. 2.5% from emails) and meeting booked rate (1.5% vs. 0.6%).

# **Let’s get physical**

Want to try letters as an additional or compliant way of reaching customers?

Let’s talk. Contact us at [lucas@getventa.ai](https://mailto:lucas@getventa.ai) or book a demo at <https://www.getventa.ai/trial>

launches.body:
# TL;DR

Unhaze mines data across sources like intent, hiring, technologies used, company descriptions, websites etc. and analyzes your historical deals to discover impactful buying signals. It then monitors your market and target accounts to constantly find and prioritize the best opportunities at the right time.

# **The problem**

Prospecting and lead qualification is manual, inefficient, and error-prone. Prospect-to-closed conversion rates are as low as 5%-10%.

The coarse filtering capabilities of current lead databases cause sales teams to sift through long irrelevant leads lists instead of spending their time closing high-opportunity deals. This is money, time, and energy out the window.

### **The solution**

Unhaze integrates directly into Salesforce/Hubspot and tells you which leads to prioritize working on. Gone are the days of manual work and “gut based” decision making. Instead, teams can rely on predictive AI to identify the prospects they are most likely to win.

The initial focus is on win likelihood optimization, but Unhaze can also make predictions such a recommended products, segmentation, upsell potential or even completely custom models.

# **How it works**

_1\. Data foundation_

Unhaze continuously mines both structured and unstructured data across a large palette of data points such as firmographics, geo, technographics, funding, news, intent, website content, job posts, organizational changes & new hires and more.

_2\. Analysis of past deals_

With guidance from you, Unhaze analyzes all previous deals to discover impactful signals that can predict high-conversion opportunities. Some signals are obvious while others are more subtle or only appear in certain combinations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72922&key=user_uploads/530674/4b6c7252-b344-4bb1-845a-dea75a1810fe)

_3\. Predictive monitoring of market_

Unhaze uses machine learning to continuously monitor your market and predict which accounts are most likely to convert - so you can target the right accounts at the right time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72922&key=user_uploads/530674/16e1646b-f44d-46bc-9d26-5699587da1af)

# **Does it work?**

By focusing on the right accounts and not wasting time on unlikely leads, our pilot customers can more than double win rates while markedly decreasing time spent on prospecting.

launches.tagline: Generate reliable and accurate responses to security reviews, RFPs, DDQs, and RFIs and lower your time-to-revenue.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** _Sales information requests are an important part of most sales deals. But they are long and tedious to complete accurately and need repeated involvement from senior team members. Inventive AI automates this process using AI. Our platform natively manages the fidelity of each response by providing sources, a confidence rating and automatically flagging stale content._

### **Problem ⚠️**

A sales information request like a security questionnaire, RFI, DDQ and RFP is an important step to complete in every sales deal. Each one’s a grind though! A typical sales questionnaire has an average of 77 questions and the average time to complete one is 32 human hours.

* Coordinating the completion of a sales information request usually takes days to weeks depending on the complexity. Dhiren faced this challenge with his sales team at Viewics where they had momentum in the sales motion but they knew that this step would slow down time to revenue. No one person has the answers to all the questions which makes it challenging to search for answers in a knowledge base or chase down answers from the SMEs who are senior team members → and busy with their day job!
* If an answer is found in a knowledge base, it’s difficult for the coordinator to ascertain if the content is current or obsolete. Inevitably, this uncertainty leads to a senior team member having to validate the answer. Result → Slows down the sales motion!

### **Our Solution 👋**

The Inventive AI platform automates drafting responses that can be trusted and does so in a fraction of the time compared to the current process. We do this by:

* **Generating responses grounded in facts:** We use your previous responses and connect to company knowledge bases to generate a response. For each answer, we include easily accessible citations to the sources used to generate the answer.
* **Creating a Confidence Rating:** We generate a confidence rating for each answer and automatically flag answers that need review.
* **Detecting Stale Content:** We automatically flag content that could be obsolete and thereby inaccurate.
* **Creating compelling answers:** You have control over the tone of the answers while keeping the facts intact.

Our goal is that you only have to **_verify responses,_** not create them from scratch for every sales information request. Most existing SaaS tools cater to streamlining the process of response creation. With our AI native solution, our customers only verify flagged answers while we do the heavy lifting of generating an accurate response to each question.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73748&key=user_uploads/150549/7482b2fd-7d43-4036-a5ce-50016d40c592)

### **Team** 🍻

We are an SF Bay Area native team who met through our friend’s circle and hit it off on our love and passion for AI & building businesses.

[**Dhiren**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhiren9/) previously founded and led Viewics (series-B, acquired by Roche), a SaaS company in healthcare analytics that managed data for **100Mn+ patients** across customers like Mayo Clinic, University Hospitals, and Children’s Hospitals.

[**Gaurav**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauravnemade/) was a product manager at **Google AI and Google Brain** and led go-to-market for the LLM platform - LaMDA - which eventually ended up powering Google Bard v1.

[**Vishakh**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishakhhegde/) led mission-critical Machine Learning efforts at **Ambient AI** (YC17, A16z) and has authored a book on Deep Learning. He has a Masters's in ML from Stanford.

[**Waffle**](https://photos.app.goo.gl/wbrecuk6xnHjBim68) is a world leader in sniffing for treats and cheering us up on hard days. She is our (non-AI) Happiness Agent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73748&key=user_uploads/1359485/ef976aa8-0d12-410f-a569-6b44fc5a2247)

### **Requests** 👋🏻

### **🏆 TL;DR:**

[**Fiber AI**](https://fiber.ai/) **automates SDR and BDR prospecting & outbound sales workflows using AI.** Enterprises choose our AI sales platform because we automatically find prospects, research them, and hyper-personalize outbound messages that get 80% open rates, which is 4x the industry standard.

As successful 7-figure e-commerce entrepreneurs, we manually hacked together outbound sales automations across several point solutions to scale our last business. In contrast, when we worked at Microsoft and Google, not a single employee touched outbound sales directly—instead, each organization hired different vendors that managed and configured different tools. 

Witnessing this firsthand, we’re uniquely positioned to build a platform that automates outbound sales workflows for enterprises. 

### **💯 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/331974d7-79bb-4e22-ac12-b3a140007967)

[**Adi Agashe**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adityaagashe/) **(CEO)** and [**Neel Mehta**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neel-a-mehta/) **(CTO)** are the 3-time global bestselling authors of "[Swipe to Unlock](https://www.amazon.com/Swipe-Unlock-Technology-Business-Strategy/dp/1976182190)," "[Bubble or Revolution?](https://www.amazon.com/Blockchain-Bubble-Revolution-Present-Cryptocurrencies-ebook/dp/B07T13GP1Q/)", and "[PM's Sacred Seven](https://www.amazon.com/Product-Managements-Sacred-Seven-World-Class/dp/0578740583/)" which have been translated into 11 languages. They have worked together for the last 8 years and built a profitable 7-figure e-commerce business.

Adi spent 5 years as a growth Product Manager at Microsoft, scaling Azure hybrid revenue. He graduated from Cornell University, where he studied computer science and was a Rawlings scholar (top 1.5%).

Neel was an APM (later PM) at Google, working on Google Search. He graduated in the top 5% of his class at Harvard University, where he studied computer science and was a John Harvard Scholar.

### **❌ The Problem**

**Most businesses’ deliverability rates are horrible.** There are 40+ common pitfalls that land your emails in spam. Founders are not aware of these hazards, which are often technical in nature, and commit blunders that affect their domain and email health long-term.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/45cec696-826a-4361-822f-1346e748ddcd)

**Finding relevant prospects is tedious and constantly changing.** When building a lead list, you have to manually gather data from several data sources and figure out triggers to prune this list so that your offer is relevant. Generating quality leads is extremely time-consuming and eats up 40% of a SDR’s time. What’s even more frustrating is that by the time you reach out, your offer may not be relevant anymore since the window of opportunity is often short. 

**Writing personalized emails is a massive bottleneck.** Researching each lead and writing highly personalized emails that are going to get opened requires 10 to 20 minutes per email on average. This is not scalable, which is why many businesses blast generic templates, which have horrible open and response rates.

### **🌟 Our Solution**

**Fiber AI manages domain and email health to get 80% open rates.** We automatically configure your DNS records, warm-up your emails, orchestrate emails to send optimally across all of your accounts, run multi-layer email bounce detection, and modify each outgoing email to ensure it doesn’t set off spam filters. 

**We automate lead generation with dynamic audiences.** We pull in data from 50+ data providers, including BuiltWith, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, Alexa, and more, so that you can segment your audience precisely by the companies you care about and exclude everyone else. Our audiences are dynamic, which means we will continuously look for prospects matching your targeting and add them to your audience to run our automated outbound sales sequences. Create an audience once, and put your outreach on autopilot.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/41bb740f-e065-447d-8088-f2e9bc19802b)

**AI-powered hyper-personalized emails to boost response rates.** The biggest debate in sales is choosing between relevancy and personalization—now you don’t have to. We search far and wide to find the “golden nugget” of information to connect with your prospect, and then use GPT-4 to write hyper-personalized email sequences to dramatically increase response rates.

launches.tagline: Trained on 3 years of data across 27 industries, 17k+ campaigns and 20k+ booked meetings
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋

Yuriy here - founder of AiSDR (YC S23). This is my second YC company. The first (AXDRAFT – YC W19) was acquired by Onit in 2020.

Today we’re launching **Ami**, an AI GTM agent that already knows what good outbound looks like. Ami builds your campaign, and runs it across email and LinkedIn until a meeting’s booked.

What makes it different is what happens next. Ami remembers every campaign it’s run for you, spots what isn’t working, fixes it on your say-so, and tells you what to run next.

## TL;DR

* Point Ami at your website and it builds your campaign in 20 minutes against what’s worked across 17,150+ campaigns across 27 industry-specific playbooks. 
* Every decision is driven by data, and Ami pushes back when it thinks your direction is off.
* Targeting is pain-based. Ami looks for evidence that someone has your problem right now, and validates the timing before sending a message.
* Ami remembers everything it’s run for you, so Month 3 is better than Month 1.
* Self-serve for $250/month. No demo required to start.
* **Try it at** <https://aisdr.com/ai-gtm-agent-ami/>

[Launch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z--7OETsjrs)

## The Problem

AI outbound got very good at scaling noise. But it struggled at making sales judgments.

Almost every AI SDR, ours included, assumed the human would bring the strategy, define the ICP, create the angle, and hit approve. The AI would take it from there and do it all faster than any human.

This works if you already know what a good campaign looks like. A lot of people buying these tools don’t:

* First-time founders running founder-led sales
* First sales hires
* 2-person GTM teams

Working out which of 42+ possible audiences is worth spending time on and deciding what to say is a skill built over years. 

So we handed that decision back to buyers and called it control. So did everyone else.

What came out the other end is thousands of messages and full dashboards, but zero pipeline.

The missing piece was never speed. It was judgment. And no one had automated it.

## Our Solution – Ami AI

For 3 years, we built execution: research, writing, sequencing, deliverability, reply handling. And the thing customers kept telling us was still hard was the part we hadn't automated – deciding what campaign to run in the first place, and when to stop and pivot to something else.

The number that settled it was 80% of our customers were using our campaign generator instead of building campaigns by hand, even though building gave them far more control. 

People wanted a decision rather than controls.

So we took what we learned from over 17,150 campaigns run on the platform in the past 3 years, and built the agent that does it. 

That's Ami.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/7df84866-6f8f-476e-8d12-7e12ad99005d)

### Where Ami’s judgment comes from

In a nutshell, 3 years of running outbound as a company that sells outbound. As of September 2026, this means (adding daily):

Campaigns run - 17,150

Emails sent - 2,546,096

Meetings booked - 19,501

Customers served - 1,150

Industries served - 27

Every one of those campaigns taught Ami something about what lands, in which industry, at what moment. That's the part you can't buy off the shelf, and that’s why this took three years.

**1. Ami builds your campaign from your website, CRM, and industry best practices, against everything we’ve learned:** Give Ami your URL and it reads your site, and share access to your CRM. Ami then runs what it found against your industry and the 17K+ campaigns we’ve done over 3 years, and comes back with the angles and audiences you need. You can argue with Ami: narrow the ICP, push a different angle, or ask why it picked what it did.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/c36e16a8-d236-41be-bb97-8f133a06f758)

**2. Ami targets pains:** Most tools match a profile and hope the timing is right. Ami looks for evidence someone has the problem you solve. There's no fixed database. Describe who you want and Ami finds them, with data verified at the time of the search.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/59022bd3-8755-4def-9ecb-2c47fac6b9ab)

**3. Ami remembers, and it gets better at your sales motions**: This is where Ami’s value compounds. Ami keeps every campaign it’s run for you: angles that landed, segments that went quiet, objections that kept coming up, and things you tried. It tells you what’s breaking and why when performance drops, and it makes fixes once you give the green light. Month 3 is better than Month 1 because Ami has 3 months of your outbound in its head. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/031002d5-65f8-4470-91c3-97fc2a0caae7)

An AI that learns your business and doesn’t need babysitting is what this category’s promised since Day 1 (ours included). It took 3 years, 17K campaigns, and 2.5M emails before we had enough to build it..

You don’t have to be good at outbound to win with Ami.

That’s the whole point.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114134&key=user_uploads/208580/f47e2f0d-2f4b-4255-b482-98cecdc06982)

### **What it produces**

Medians across our customer case studies:

Connection acceptance (LinkedIn) - 32.42%

Response rate (email) - 4.92%

Positive response rate (email) - 1.02%

Positive response rate (LinkedIn) - 3.4%

Meeting booked rate - 0.54%

Meetings per 1,000 leads - 6–10

## The team

**Yuriy Zaremba (CEO)**: 2x YC founder. 8+ years in B2B sales. Previously co-founder and CEO of AXDRAFT (W19, acquired by Onit in 2020).

AiSDR’s team of 35 works across the United States, Ukraine, and Poland. 200+ customers. 4.6/5 on G2 across 101 reviews. SOC 2 certified.

## Our ask

* **Try it at** <https://aisdr.com/ai-gtm-agent-ami/>. Solo plan is $250 per month, self-serve, with no demo required. YC companies get 50% discount.
* **Share the signup link**. Send it to someone who might find it useful since signup is free.
* **Follow us on LinkedIn.** Share our launch posts.
* **Tell us what broke for you**. If you’re doing founder-led sales and you bounced off an AI outbound tool, we want to hear where it failed: targeting, messaging, execution. Conversations like this are what built Ami.
* **Intros**. B2B SaaS founders at 10-200 person companies that want to try AI outreach.

## tl;dr

**AiSDR automates sales prospecting.** Our software uses generative AI to write and send sales emails to prospective customers. Once a prospect engages, AiSDR automatically corresponds with the prospect with the goal of getting a meeting booked. In just 2 months, AiSDR already has 24 customers. The response rate of our sales emails is on par with the industry’s rate for emails written by humans. This is our second time as YC founders after we sold our first company AXDRAFT (W19) to Onit Inc.

If you want to learn more - [book a demo with us](https://calendly.com/aisdr-intro/demo).

## Problem

Do you want to scale your SDR team without growing your headcount or significantly raising your operating costs? AiSDR will make it easier for your business to stay lean and mean. 

If you’re faced with any of these challenges, AiSDR is the SDR for you:

* Inbound/outbound leads are lost because you can’t answer in <10 minutes
* You run 1-3 generic email campaigns that don’t convert because you don’t have the time to create personalized campaigns
* You’re uncomfortable with sending follow-ups because they seem “salesy” or “spammy”
* You want to scale your email outreach but you don’t have the budget to confidently hire an SDR

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74643&key=user_uploads/208580/06a07780-7d1c-4c5e-8daf-a0db770f621d)

## Solution

**For a fraction of the cost of a full-time, in-house SDR,** AiSDR will use your leads and personas to (a) create personalized email campaigns for each lead, (b) send personalized follow-ups to leads, and (c) correspond and drive leads to book a meeting with you. 

This will help you scale your outreach without increasing headcount while giving you the freedom to experiment with campaigns before hiring your first full-time SDR.

Long story short, AiSDR is the AI SDR that will grow your pipeline, optimize SDR costs, and give you the freedom to reinvest revenue into growing your business.

## How it works

AiSDR leverages generative AI to create personalized email campaigns at scale using lead data and sales personas. Since AiSDR never needs to sleep, it will respond to and follow up with engaged leads in less than 10 minutes, ensuring that **prospective clients never fall through the cracks** due to lack of time.

AiSDR will also help with developing and fine-tuning personas, cleaning leads, and warming up inboxes so that emails don’t land in spam.

TL;DR - [Topo](https://www.topo.io/) is an AI sales agent trained specifically for each company. The agent is trained to handle all outbound tasks automatically: finding the best leads in the industry-specific channels and then automatically contacting prospects with a personalized approach.

### **The problem 🤯**

B2B lead generation is broken.

It's difficult to generate outbound pipeline as we did in the past years: mass mailing over the TAM based on demographics criteria.

It's especially very human-intensive for a founder, a full cycle sales team, or even an SDR dedicated to the task.

Finally, the cost of implementing a high-quality outbound strategy has completely exploded.

### **Our Solution 🥳**

AI allows us to automate these tasks by doing like a top performer.

**What makes a top performer?**

* They know the product, the industry, the pain points, and the company's value proposition perfectly.
* They will find the right leads, ready to buy, based on buying signals in the industry-specific channels or on the company's website visitors.

_For example, the buying signals for a dev tool will likely happen more on GitHub, whereas for an HRIS, it will happen on LinkedIn or job boards._

That's what we do: **Create the smartest AI sales agent on the market - custom-trained for each company!**

### **How it works? ✨**

1. Train your agent to become an expert on your business thanks to various knowledge sources of your company (Knowledge base, CRM, Call transcripts…).
2. The agent will then scan the lead sources specific to your industry and start to suggest enriched leads with a personalized approach.
3. In co-pilot mode, you will be able to validate the leads and approaches to train the agent and then switch to autopilot once satisfied with the lead quality.
4. The agent will book meetings in your calendar.

### **Meet our team 🤝**

[Dan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danelkaim/) and [Robin](https://linkedin.com/in/robin-philibert) were together as Sales and Head of Outbound at Aircall from $10M to $120M ARR - they perfectly know the sales and SDR profession to reproduce best practices.

[Léonard](https://linkedin.com/in/leonard-henriquez) is a Data Science and AI expert and managed an engineering team of 10 people in his previous startup.

We are the right team to launch a smart AI sales agent :)

### **Our ask 🙏**

If you're looking to create pipeline via outbound and you tick one of these boxes:

* You are afraid of automating because the outreach or the leads would not be qualitative enough
* You don't want to recruit a first sales before your PMF

It pushes the most relevant content to buyers to animate sales cycles, encouraging buy-in while alleviating the sales rep from endless admin and follow-ups.

Hello YC 👋

We are thrilled to share [Topo.io](http://Topo.io) with you - a Buyer Engagement Platform that helps B2B sellers better engage buyers to accelerate closing.

🤯 **The Problem**

**The B2B selling process is broken.**

85% of B2B buying decisions happen outside of conversations with the sales rep.

This leaves Sales teams facing:

* longer sales cycles
* lack of momentum
* increasing number of stakeholders
* and difficulty in scaling a proven sales process.

Having a background in B2B sales, we experienced these problems first-hand. Unable to find a tool that could solve these problems, we decided to build one ourselves 💪

⚡️ **The Solution**

Topo is a Buyer Engagement Platform that allows sales reps to keep all of their interactions in one place, facilitating collaboration, increasing engagement, and creating sales motions at scale. It includes the following key features:

* **Digital Sales Room** - Establish a deal hub that sellers can use to engage buyers, pushing them the most relevant content to animate down times during a deal.

* **Analytics** - Observe when, how, and how long your customers/prospects are interacting with your content to better prioritize opportunities via deal scoring.
* **Integrations** - Create a workspace from your CRM (Salesforce & HubSpot), keep your data up-to-date with two-way sync, be informed about the latest buyer activity via Slack, and enrich your workspace with content from your existing tools (Gong, Loom, Google Slide, Youtube, etc.).

🔥**Our customers shortened their sales cycles by 30% just two quarters after implementing Topo**🔥

**👫 Who are we?**

We’re a team of 9 people, French and American - from Paris, France. 🇫🇷

We’re all from B2B SaaS companies (ex Hubspot, Algolia, Aircall, Hivebrite...) with a strong background in GTM. It was during our previous experience at Aircall that the Topo adventure was born.

launches.body:
**tl;dr:** [Speck](https://tryspeck.com) is a browser extension that makes automating repetitive web tasks easy. Our customers use Speck to extract data, perform LinkedIn outreach, collect the newest research papers, gather data about social media groups, and more!

Hey everyone! We’re Lucas and Raghav, the founding team behind Speck.

## 🤔 The Problem

People spend precious time doing menial and repetitive browser-based tasks, such as entering data into CRMs, posting multiple job listings for recruiting, reaching out to contacts on LinkedIn, extracting data from websites, and other similar chores.

These tasks are irritating for most knowledge workers, yet they do not have any way to simplify their workflow. Low-code solutions like UiPath cost tens of thousands of dollars and require a dedicated automations team. On the other hand, executing web-based workflows is outside of the scope of workflow tools like Zapier. 

## 💡 The Solution

With Speck, you can automate any workflow easily **without having any coding knowledge**. Our browser extension allows you to **record workflows just by doing them**. Speck automatically translates your workflows into repeatable steps, making it simple for anyone to create web-based automations and data extraction processes

By keeping track of intent, the **browser automations will repair themselves automatically** when something goes wrong! These workflows can be executed live or scheduled asynchronously on a remote browser. Now, our users can spend less time doing menial chores and more time focusing on higher-impact tasks. 

Since pivoting 2 weeks ago and launching our beta, we’ve gotten our extension published on the Chrome Web Store and onboarded our first paying customers.

Making an automation takes less than 60 seconds.

**Step 1** - Record your workflow

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79389&key=user_uploads/1500358/94fd9ad1-319a-4bc7-a0a7-6bb294fa7e60)

**Step 2** - Extract Text

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79389&key=user_uploads/1500358/47e0ad7b-7e38-4df6-9be1-7ae58a6fbf85)

**Step 3** - Run

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79389&key=user_uploads/1500358/1560a1cc-c750-4884-bc8f-07d9391ea920)

And this is just the start! Together with our users, we’re making progress towards our vision of an autonomous LLM agent capable of generating complex automations - one workflow at a time.

## 🏆 The Team

Hey YC, we're Grant and Jarrek, and we're excited to launch crmCopilot!

crmCopilot automates data entry, proactively manages your tasks, and helps you quickly find critical information across all your interactions… so you can spend less time on grunt work and more time with customers!

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rUnCUGin7U](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rUnCUGin7U&ab_channel=crmCopilot)

**The Problem**

I (Grant) spent four years at Salesforce as a Sales Engineer and saw firsthand how frustrating CRMs can be. Despite massive investments, CRMs often become messy and unreliable, burdened with stale data, duplicates, and manual data entry. CRMs promise so much, but never live up to their full potential.  

**“The biggest thing I learned at Salesforce was that everyone hates Salesforce…”** 

So why is this the case? Why hasn’t this been solved already? Well, it’s a hard problem, and many have tried over the years (Salesforce included): 

* CRMs are incredibly complicated, unique, and accumulate tech debt
* There is an enormous amount of source data to make sense of (emails, calls, files, transcripts, etc.)

 

**Why It Matters**

Sales reps spend 30-50% of their time on grunt work (CRM updates, follow-up emails, quotes/documentation, etc.), and yet we still can't rely on our CRM for reporting, accountability, or automation. 

Businesses suffer from:

* Wasted time - on grunt work instead of customers 
* Unreliable data - lack of accountability, reporting, automation, and insights
* Revenue left on the table - opportunities fall through the cracks

 

**Our Solution**

CRMs are absolutely critical to our business, but they need to be smarter… and thanks to AI, they can be. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91926&key=user_uploads/318114/001c4bc7-125d-4415-bbee-a50768315513)

We built crmCopilot—an AI assistant specifically optimized for front-office teams:

* **Automated CRM Updates** - crmCopilot intelligently identifies when your CRM needs updating, drafting accurate and timely updates that you can approve with just one click.
* **Task Management** (Cover Your Ass) - crmCopilot proactively identifies next steps, tracks important follow-ups, and ensures no opportunity or critical task ever slips through the cracks.
* **Global Search** - Instantly find important details across emails, CRM records, calendar events, call recordings, notes, and documents with one simple search.

crmCopilot integrates into your existing tools/workflow, enhancing your systems rather than replacing them.

**Our Story**

We (Grant and Jarrek) met at our last startup, Northbeam. Grant was employee #1 & Head of Sales, Jarrek was employee #2 and Head of Product Development. We helped grow that business from $100k to $10m in revenue in about 15 months. We built a lot of trust in one another, we both love building products, and we both love building companies. 

**Call to Action**

We're thrilled to start onboarding users from our waitlist. If you're tired of grunt work, bad data, missing information, or task anxiety, join our waitlist or schedule a call with our team. 

\
Sign up or schedule a demo at [crmcopilot.co](http://crmcopilot.co)

### TLDR

# There are three T’s in sales: **Territory**, **Talent**, and **Timing**. What if we could solve the hardest one… **Timing?**

### Quantic provides better data so sales reps can reach out to the **right people,** with the **right message**, at the **right time.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79117&key=user_uploads/318114/f3f42547-5b9a-470b-8220-d7eae8602281)

Today, sales reps navigate between countless tools looking for an edge, an insight, or a lead. They are limited by their time and their workflows. In the future, reps won’t waste time doing monotonous data work, they will be able to **focus on what they do best, selling**.

We built Quantic with the mission of 10x-ing sales reps. We make it easy for reps to **research their customers, identify opportunities,** and **optimize their time.**

### The Problem

* Don’t know which accounts to go after

  * Don’t know which are ready to buy
* Don’t have a good entry point
  * Hard to find the right contacts
  * Hard to craft personalized/engaging messaging every time
* Don’t have enough time
  * Existing tools are clunky and filled with junk data
  * Don’t have time to do thorough research

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/rkH_Xlq76A5Y12HD7eoSkE-WRbTbBuU2xsZPLj6PSdx_oEzIYX8eljoo_TBg4cKomrP15A3xnH30SJ_rVWaJ1zdzcscYjQdNHigivFCGrnWch_erxpPx08S_z9buX1hPPGegN1k73yx1ApCM_UqHaQE)

### The Solution

**Better data allows reps to reach out at the right time with the right message**

* Quantic’s data is
  * Fresh/relevant
  * Personalized to you
  * Reliable
* With Quantic, sales reps
  * Identify hot accounts & contacts
  * Send relevant messages with context
  * At the right time

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79117&key=user_uploads/318114/87fac7fe-80a4-4bdf-a027-2fbc0cbecc21)

One of our customers sells physical security products. They look for buying signals such as crime in their area, moving offices, opening up new stores, press releases, fundraising, etc. In their first week using the platform they **found an article announcing a new office development**. They were able to identify the right contact at the business, reach out to them with this article, and **immediately schedule a demo.**

**tl;dr:** \
Hey everyone! We are [Richard](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yuchenghe/) and [Kathryn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kathrynwoohoo/), and we're here to present [Openmart](http://www.openmart.ai), **a platform that helps startups who sell to local businesses discover leads easily based on their specific needs.**\
\
Over the past several years, we have worked as brand operators, the first product manager, and the first engineer at high-growth SaaS startups. We crossed paths at Pinterest and have been good friends ever since.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78559&key=user_uploads/1629158/eb4bdb54-7f60-4a76-a2d3-a543e2f9c886)

**Problem**\
Based on our conversations with sales teams from various startups, we identified the following challenges:

1. Finding SMB leads is difficult because there's no easy way to locate them. People often have to search randomly through platforms like Google Maps, Yelp, and Yellow Pages. **Companies like ZoomInfo charge upwards of $50,000 a year for an account.**
2. Filtering out these SMB leads isn't easy. We observe different leads filtering requirements from our clients, and each of them, after receiving a list from ZoomInfo or others, still needs to spend days on manual research to determine if the business is a fit.

TLDR: Apten is an **omni-channel AI agent** that engages and nurtures leads across **text, call, and email, and webchat.**

Webchat specifically has been around for ages - but when a lead starts a conversation on the website and leaves halfway through, **they’re** **gone.**

Apten is not only able to start a conversation through webchat, but **proactively reach out via SMS/voice/email once the lead goes inactive.**

Today, Apten automates sales/marketing for hundreds of thousands of leads each month - we work with some of the largest enterprises in consumer services (industries including home services, healthcare, education, financial services, and insurance).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63At2HXNX4k

# **The Problem**

B2C services companies today **(insurance, home services, financial services, education, etc)** rely on a combination of call centers, dialers, email/sms marketing automation systems to convert new leads.

These systems fall short because:

* Human teams are required to scale up dialing/call efforts (leads slip through the cracks)
* SMS/email automations are typically one-way, static sequences without personalization

# **Our Solution**

Apten automates sales and marketing for B2C enterprises with:

* **Omni-channel capabilities**: set up a single conversational flow that works across SMS, voice, email, and webchat.
  * Apten maintains unified memory across SMS, voice, emai, and webchat (just like a human does) to **personalize conversations at scale**
  * Apten can also **switch between channels** at anytime to **meet a lead where they want to be met**
  * Move leads through different conversational flows depending on **where they are in the customer/lead journey**
* **Intelligent follow-up:** Apten will not only personalize follow-ups based on what it knows about a lead or a past conversation, but it will also dynamically adjust **when to follow-up based on a lead’s repsonse**
  * Personalized AI voicemails can be left on dial attempts that go to an answering machine
  * Apten is able to use local presence dialing to auto-match the number it dials from to one that best matches the lead’s area code
* **AI tools:** Apten can take actions with your systems (scheduling, dialers, quote APIs, etc)
* **Human in the loop:** Handles transfers to your human team at any time (cold or warm). Apten can also dynamically transfer to specific numbers depending on
* **Reliability:** setup custom guardrails that automatically detect non-compliant messages and proactively fix them before they’re sent to the lead

# **Our Ask**

If you’re an enterprise that:

* Falls in a consumer services industry (home services, financial services, insurance, education, healthcare, auto, law, etc)
* Generates a high volume of leads (5k+ leads / mo)
* Uses marketing automation (drip texts/emails, dialer sequences) + a sales team/call center to engage leads over the phone

We’d love to chat - you can find us at http://apten.ai.

launches.title: 🚛 Soff: Supply Chain Operating System for Manufacturing Companies
launches.tagline: Unify supply chain data and automate core workflows.
launches.body:
**⛓️ TL;DR**

[Soff](https://soff.ai) is a supply chain operating system for manufacturing companies. We automate data entry, requesting quotes, comparing quotes, and issuing purchase orders. Our customers save dozens of hours a week spent on repetitive manual tasks.

👬 **Team**

We met five years ago while studying at the CDTM in Munich. Most recently, [Berni](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hausleitnerb/) worked as a full-stack engineer at Tesla on the Autopilot team, whilst [Raban](https://linkedin.com/in/raban) finished his engineering master’s at Stanford. At Tesla, Berni built tons of internal tooling and saw the supply chain inefficiencies firsthand. During the batch, Raban worked as a purchasing manager for one of our customers.

🌋 **Problem**

Supply chain data is spread across multiple platforms, such as ERPs, custom spreadsheets, and email inboxes, leading to inefficiencies and a lack of visibility. Supply Chain Managers spend hours each week searching through emails and spreadsheets to track the status of parts procurement, from request to quote to award. This process is not only time-consuming but also prone to errors and delays. For example, changes in production schedules require Supply Chain Managers to follow up with all suppliers individually to adjust their purchase orders. Quotes that aren’t used are lost in the abyss of email inboxes. Suppliers are reluctant to upload quotes to yet another portal and often fail to notify about delays, leading to costly production standstills.

🚛 **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83460&key=user_uploads/1755188/cacbe907-12f5-429f-9391-9ba957afa746)

Soff connects suppliers, parts, and quotes into a single platform.

We integrate with ERPs and email to automate supplier communication, send RFQs, and issue purchase orders. We turn unstructured email and PDFs into SQL-ready data, injecting quotes directly into the ERP system. We eliminate the need for manual data entry and dedicated supplier portals, thus increasing supplier response rates.

Our platform stores quote data, ensuring no loss of information when switching suppliers or moving from single-source to dual-source. It also tracks parts from the initial request through to the final receipt, providing a complete overview for supplier management.

Soff enables manufacturers to deliver higher-quality products faster. Companies like SpaceX (Warpdrive), Rivian (Basecamp), and Apple (Incline) spend millions on building their in-house supply chain tools—we bring that level of efficiency to any manufacturer.

**❤️ How you can help**

If you work in Supply Chain or work(ed) at a manufacturing company we’d love to connect. Send us a message at [founders@soff.ai](mailto:founders@soff.ai). 📨

Simple AI can make AI powered phone calls on your behalf. Simple can wait on hold and navigate phone trees. Simple can make phone calls in 33 countries using 15 different languages, or even call 10 different stores at the same time.

We tested a beta version of the app extensively with our initial set of 1000 users. \
We started Simple AI with the simple vision to bring the power of AI to regular people. We went through YC’s Summer 24 batch. During YC, we saw many startups working on ideas that leverage the new AI and LLM technology to upend various industries. But no one was working on AI for consumers.

It turns out people really hate making phone calls, and our AI is pretty good at it.

In fact, it’s _better_ than a human at certain tasks. Zach and Cat both needed a new eye doctor and independently set out to find one that would 1) take our new insurance, and 2) had availability soon. Zach did some research on the internet and got an appointment 3 weeks out. Cat had Simple call 15 optometrists near Potrero Hill and got hers in 6 days.

We give people access to an AI assistant at their fingertips. Read more about our launch on [our blog](https://usesimple.ai/blog/launch) or try it out today at [https://usesimple.ai/join](https://usesimple.ai/join?inviteCode=launchyc).

Unusual creates and suggests media engineered to improve how AI talks about your brand – driving you more leads. This is the first “AI Relations” tool – public relations for AI models.

**The problem:**

Every day, your customers rely more on ChatGPT for their buying decisions. 

Getting tools like ChatGPT to send you leads is a lot more than GEO/AEO; it’s more like running a PR campaign – strategically building credibility and authority with models themselves.

**The solution:**

We built a platform that helps you improve AI’s holistic picture of your brand – what we’re calling “AI Relations.”

https://youtu.be/EIkyCu3kTt4 

We break this into three components, all of which Unusual manages:

1. Filling key knowledge gaps – publishing LLM-optimized content full of information LLMs are searching for, but don’t have: like a reference manual for your company. Check out ours here: https://llms.unusual.ai  
2. Getting you on the map – flagging the 3rd party media sources LLMs look to in your industry.
3. Nuanced reporting – analyzing how LLMs think about your company, and giving you extremely detailed reports on why they make the recommendations they do.

Unusual also track AI crawls of your content, so you can measure when it’s getting picked up and referenced by LLMs, helping you track ROI.

Quality wins fast with AI systems – content with rich and needed information is quickly picked up and referenced.

For [Parley](https://parley.so), an early customer, Unusual identified a key gap in what Perplexity knew about the space of SOC2 compliant AI for law firms.
