launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Kashyab and Rishi, co-founders of Verbiflow 😁

# tl;dr

Verbiflow is the all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process. Capture leads with intelligent prospecting that identifies high-potential prospects based on real-time events and smart scheduling & routing that instantly assigns those leads to the best-suited sales rep. Manage your pipeline with complete flexibility, defining and tracking custom KPIs across all your sales interactions. Automate reminders and workflows to keep deals moving forward, all within a single, unified platform.

**Ask:** warm intros to sales leaders 😇 (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)

<https://youtu.be/0jZayvEkiI4>

# The Problem 👎

Sales teams are grappling with inefficiencies that plague every step of the sales process, from chasing down leads to sealing the deal. For sales reps, the clock is their enemy: they spend just 35% of their time actually selling, leaving about 6.5 hours a day tangled up in manual chores like data entry, prospect hunting, call logging, and scheduling follow-ups. This time sink costs companies roughly $68,000 per rep each year in lost productivity—like paying for a chef who spends most of their shift washing dishes instead of cooking. It’s not just money down the drain; it’s missed chances, too. Leads are 9x more likely to turn into customers if contacted within 5 minutes, but reps buried under admin work can’t keep up, letting golden opportunities slip away.

Account Executives (AEs) are under pressure to close complex deals, but they’re stuck piecing together past interactions from scattered emails, linkedin messages, notes, and tools to get full context on a deal. This chaos makes it nearly impossible to remember key discussions or spot issues threatening the deal like price objections or competitor mentions early enough to act. AEs lack the real-time insights to tackle blockers as such head-on. Meanwhile, they’re bogged down tracking multiple deals across clunky, disconnected systems, while needing to manually update them too. To top it off, deals often land with the wrong AE—like asking a barber to fix your car; they’re skilled with scissors, not engines, and your car’s not going anywhere fast. Win rates tank, and growth goals slip out of reach.

**The outcome?** A frustrated sales team that’s overworked, stretched thin, and underdelivering on the company’s revenue goals.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfsJ9u8AMu5T7GayrI8W-Tj0Tcjadt4A_-xcLxSh-k5kba2Es3uSw9_DWUEHGX4U8X7shcpXwSdLexdlKMBRZl9IYAZLtts1nNR52_7WCMkBvsAT2uVP8vSz3uW34dz6QA6wxTwnw?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

# Our Solution 🤩

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/5e2c41a3-b5c3-4a66-9342-21d027cba0b0)

**Time Wasted on Manual Tasks** \
Verbiflow automates lead identification, data enrichment, scheduling, and pulls in all your sales interactions. This eliminates the repetitive manual work that eats up 6.5 hours of a rep’s day, letting them focus purely on selling.

**Missed Opportunities and Poor Deal Assignment**\
Verbiflow ensures leads are contacted instantly with automated follow-ups—hitting the 5-minute window when conversions are 9x more likely—while smart routing matches those deals to the best-suited AE based on expertise and performance history. This keeps opportunities alive and optimally assigned without manual effort or guesswork.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/e5ba9f9e-6e63-423c-b61a-3414151bf03a)

**Lack of Centralized Context** \
A unified pipeline consolidates all deal-related emails, messages, calls, & notes, into one view. AEs get a full picture instantly, without digging through scattered sources.

**Sales Blockers**\
AI-powered KPIs flag specific hurdles—like pricing objections, competitor mentions, or price consciousness—giving AEs precise insights to resolve issues quickly.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeog_b3ymaSnvHZeJ97Ybp1ql3WqyZwPQBkRwiZyOl5IajGnwuEgU3HTSxbQIH64diOOKnwFsiCQGa5-39n0lKEfs-GEdFzu8tKR-ycfu_tJTVEqnm1J-mxcqIn5Pywph6_ZS-WqQ?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

# The Team 🚀

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/2fb432c3-988f-4297-b4aa-984792d8837d)

We’ve been spending 10+ hours every day with each other since 2024 & have shared a love for building, movies, & music since we met.

Kashyab has seen sales teams struggle with disorganization and inefficiencies across the board—from billion-dollar giants to seed-stage startups. Rishi has witnessed the fallout: sales teams buckling under high turnover and missed revenue goals, often due to fragmented data and poor handoffs. Together, we bring 7 years of experience building integrations and shaping B2B SaaS products, blending technical expertise with real-world sales insights. Our hands-on understanding of these problems, paired with our ability to ship fast, makes us the perfect team to fix what’s broken in sales.

# Ask 🙌

We’re pouring our all into Verbiflow and could use your help:

* Warm intros to sales leaders (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)
* Learn more [here](https://verbiflow.com/) & [book a demo if you’re interested!](https://app.verbiflow.com/calendar)

# **❌ The Problem**

**Small firms don’t know how to deal with clients**.\
_Or at least, that’s what Ethan saw through visiting \~80 firms in his previous legal startup._ They couldn’t effectively:

* intake new clients
* do follow-ups to close clients
* keep clients updated throughout their cases

**Lawyers are stuck**—if they answer calls, they lose billable hours and time. If they don’t, they lose potential clients.

**Currently**, receptionists, intake specialists, case managers, and personal assistants eliminate those issues, but cost $60k+ per year each and it’s very difficult to find and train good ones (we met one lawyer who went through 3 receptionists in 6 weeks)—and outsourcing is unreliable and still expensive.

**Vicious cycle**: law firms want to spend more on advertising to get more clients, but getting more clients requires a larger support staff, and having a larger support staff means they can’t spend more on advertising. This causes stagnation.

# ✅ **Our Solution: The AI Support Staff For Law Firms**

We created the all-in-one system that intakes, closes, updates, and manages clients with AI agents that are 5X better and 10X cheaper when benchmarked against humans. It’s like you’re running your law firm, but on easy mode.

**Intake**: Luna, our multilingual AI intake specialist:

* empathetically intakes clients
* convinces callers to book consultations
* answers questions
* forwards callers to the appropriate attorney

Her multimodal features let her take payments, retrieve client data, send information through texts during the call, and simultaneously communicate with other attorneys about what’s happening in her call. She is the most advanced law firm intake system ever created.

**Client communication**: Jess, our client manager:

* interacts with clients via SMS
* does personalized lead follow-up to get leads to sign a retainer
* keeps clients updated throughout their case
* schedules and reschedules meetings

She does this by integrating into law firm CRMs and case management software. She increases conversion rates with lead follow-up, saves attorneys dozens of hours per week—allowing them to handle more cases—and heavily decreases their operational human costs.

**5X better, 10X cheaper** than human staff—helping law firms reach peak performance.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

Know a lawyer drowning in calls? Send them this.\
(or our website, [Caseflood.ai](http://Caseflood.ai))

Are you a lawyer? We’re already helping law firms across the US streamline their operations—if you run a firm and want **more revenue, less busywork, and happier clients**, [let’s talk](https://cal.com/ethanhilton).\
(_use promo code **YCW25** and we’ll waive the $3,000 setup fee)_

launches.body:
### **TLDR**

[**Cuckoo**](https://www.cuckoo.so) is a real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support. Companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty use Cuckoo in Zoom and in-person meetings for even the most technical discussions. 

Here an example of us having a product, sales, and partner meeting with our W25 batchmates and one of our partners in Japan: [**https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0**](https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0)

— 

Hey everyone! We are [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) and [Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and we are building Cuckoo to help global teams talk to their customers worldwide. [Give it a try](https://www.cuckoo.so) in your next global meeting 🌏

### **Why?**

**Language barriers are a big challenge even for global companies.** We experienced this firsthand in Korea, where we hosted community meetups, inviting product leaders around the world.

On the one hand, many nuances and details can get lost between languages, especially during technical conversations. On the other hand, speakers often felt isolated, unable to follow Korean discussions, and missed valuable opportunities to network and promote their products.

### **Problem**

Take Matt, a Solutions Engineer at PagerDuty APJ, who engages weekly with customers in Korea and Japan. These conversations are complicated not just by language barriers but also by technical details—think complex troubleshooting scenarios.

### **Solution**

**Cuckoo provides real-time translation tailored for you and your customers.** It instantly learns technical details from your documents—pitch decks, meeting notes, API docs—and delivers context-aware translation in 20+ languages.

### **How it works**

Invite Cuckoo to your online meeting. For in-person conversations, you can capture audio directly from your laptop.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/829469eb-8895-44f0-b686-b2c45bb2f716)

Upload relevant documents (pitch decks, API docs, user manuals, etc.) to help Cuckoo understand the general context and key terms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/64f98ba9-db35-43ca-b791-45ca41cd442f)

As the conversation unfolds, your and your customer can view live translations in your preferred languages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/cd8cd259-5e60-4bb2-bfd1-808ea19577bc)

### **How our customers use Cuckoo**

We—_our first customer_—use Cuckoo everyday to demo and collect user feedback. Here’s how other teams use Cuckoo. 

* Snowflake — Hosting global customers at their Customer Experience Centers


* PagerDuty — Troubleshooting with local cloud partners in Korea and Japan
* ClickHouse — Team sync between the APAC and HQ office
* dbt Labs — Webinars for APAC customers and partners
* Weights & Biases — Hosting Seoul and Tokyo meetups with HQ executives

Cuckoo is also used by enterprises beyond the tech industry, including healthcare (SNOMED), manufacturing (SeAH Steel), and retail (GS).

### **Asks**

Are you dealing with cross-regional operations? Do you work with international customers regularly, or are you planning to expand into new markets?

* **Try out Cuckoo** at [www.cuckoo.so](http://www.cuckoo.so) — your first conversation is on us!
* **Let’s chat!** — We can hop on a quick call—we’ll speak in Korean and Japanese so you can see how Cuckoo works with different languages.
* [**Schedule a meeting**](https://cal.com/cuckoohq/30min) — We’d love to learn more about your language challenges and how we can help. 
* **Email us** at [founders@cuckoo.so](https://mailto:founders@cuckoo.so) — Tell us how your first meeting went, and send any feedback or thoughts!

### **A bit about us**

[Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) first met in 2015 through a student club at KAIST, where we organized an annual international conference for undergraduate students. Since then, we have been talking about starting a company together.

launches.title: Peppr AI: The world's first AI-powered knowledge capture platform
launches.tagline: Enabling teams of any scale to move at startup speed
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Lost knowledge is lost productivity.

Peppr AI turns scattered company data into a living, self-improving knowledge hub to fuel faster decisions across your organization. Through this, Peppr ensures that **no matter** **how much your team scales in size, it can still operate with the same speed as the leanest startups.** 

**The Problem**

As companies scale, their teams inevitably grow—and so does their information. Projects multiply, contacts proliferate, and goals stack up. Critical details sink into buried Slack threads, outdated Confluence docs, and a myriad of PM tools. This not only leads to incessant handoff meetings and endless email threads, but **90% of critical knowledge remains undocumented (in large U.S. businesses) due to inefficient knowledge-sharing.**

### **Our Solution**

Peppr AI is built to solve these deep-seated knowledge bottlenecks.

**Unlike tools that rely on employees manually documenting what they do (which we all know they don’t ;)**, Peppr autonomously captures critical insights hidden in engineering workflows—surfacing the knowledge that typically goes undocumented.

[Peppr AI Demo](https://youtu.be/toz3hokheXs)

By **autonomously ingesting data** from key platforms, Peppr:

1. **Auto-Generates Internal Documentation**
   * Creates synthesized summaries of daily activity from Slack, Notion, Jira, etc., keeping everyone up to speed.
2. **Offers Intelligent, Real-Time Insights**
   * Pinpoints blockers in projects and recommends intelligent workflows or POCs (Points of Contact) to resolve them.
3. **Develops “Virtual Employee Minds”**
   * Retains institutional knowledge, so when employees leave or are away, their expertise doesn’t have to be waited on and doesn’t walk out the door with them.
4. **Supercharges Existing AI Tools**
   * Empowers AI tools like Cursor and Glean with the most advanced, continuously updating knowledge base, enabling them to operate with deeper context and greater accuracy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/ea6c5c9c-368e-451e-978b-fd817e630b03)

Our ‘virtual employee’ dashboard doesn’t just track productivity—it unlocks hidden insights, revealing impact and expertise across the org in real-time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/11f1a5c2-30bf-4cb9-8404-bf369d4b9ebe)

A command center for execution—Peppr’s team-wide dashboard pinpoints roadblocks, suggests the fastest resolutions, and ensures work never stalls.

### **Why It Matters**

In the perfect information system, no one wastes time hunting for answers, waiting for replies, or sitting through redundant meetings. **Unfortunately, for most organizations today, it's the opposite.** 

Engineers get blocked searching for past solutions instead of shipping faster. Managers struggle with visibility. Teams waste hours trying to align.

**Peppr changes this.**

Unlike other AI-powered tools, which only surface information that employees have manually written down, **Peppr AI captures and records the knowledge that never makes it into documentation** – so work moves forward instead of in circles.

And because every productivity tool, AI agent, and search system is only as powerful as the data it relies on, Peppr doesn’t just unify knowledge—it supercharges all your existing systems. **Like an internal Scale AI**, it continuously organizes, refines, and contextualizes your data, ensuring every one of your organization’s systems operates at peak efficiency. **No bottlenecks. No blind spots. Just pure execution at startup speed—no matter how big you grow.**

### **Our Ask**

* **Connect us to Series B+ Startups and Enterprise Teams (30+ Employees)** that are struggling with growing silos, inefficiencies, and lost productivity.

**TLDR:** TripleZip automates complex accounting tasks for Commercial Real Estate firms, cutting admin costs and lowering legal risk.

**❌ The Problem: Expensive and error-prone accounting**

* CRE firms pay $$$ for lawyers to manually extract data from their leases
* Then they pay $$$ for accountants to reconcile tenant accounts
* The whole process takes 3+ months & often has costly errors.

We learned about the problem from our parents, who own commercial real estate in San Antonio, TX. After trying existing CRE accounting software, we found that the entire process relied on error-prone manual entry and expensive consulting services.

**✅ Our Solution: Replace manual entry with AI**

* TripleZip extracts data from leases with AI (more accurately than humans)
* TripleZip feeds that data into an accounting engine which reconciles accounts instantly
* Done in <1 day, 10X cheaper than hiring a consultant or service firm

We’ve started by automating the most complex part of CRE accounting: Triple-net (NNN) reconciliation. This process accounts for up to 1/3 of the accounting effort for a large CRE firm and often results in expensive human errors and audits.

By reducing the overhead costs of accounting and avoiding costly audits related to NNN reconciliations, we aim to improve our customer’s margins by as much as 25% percent.

launches.tagline: A conversational agent that prescreens patients like an intake nurse.
launches.body:
### **Introducing Paratus – AI-Powered Patient Intake**

**TL;DR**

Patients wait months for an appointment, often with no guidance or symptom tracking in the meantime. When they finally see a doctor, the first 5-10 minutes of the visit are wasted gathering history instead of diagnosing and treating.

**Right now, there are only two ways to handle patient intake:**

* **Static intake forms** – Miss key details, forcing doctors to play catch-up.
* **Triage nurses** – Costly, difficult to scale, and still prone to oversight.

Paratus changes this. Our AI-powered intake assistant gathers symptoms, flags concerns, and delivers a structured clinical summary before the visit even starts—so doctors walk in fully informed.

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/KHh7fp5svY8).

### **It’s Time for a New Wave of AI-Powered Intake**

✅ **Conversational AI engages patients before their visit,** collecting deeper insights than any form ever could.\
✅ **Doctor-approved triage** – Uses **500+ Schmitt-Thompson protocols** and cross-checks medical literature.\
✅ **Instant structured reports** – Doctors walk in fully prepared with:

* Symptom history & differential considerations
* Next steps & testing recommendations
* A pre-visit SOAP note for the EHR
* A full conversation transcript for review

**Think of it as a triage nurse who never misses a detail—at a fraction of the cost.**

### **How It Works**

1. **Instant Patient Connection** – The patient clicks an SMS link and connects with our AI assistant.
2. **Conversational AI Consultation** – Our AI dynamically adapts to responses, uncovering key details just like a triage nurse.
3. **Automated Pre-Visit Reports** – We run the full transcript through our fine-tuned LLM, extracting structured insights for the doctor.

### **The Problem: Long Waits & Inefficient Intake**

* **Months-long wait times** leave patients in limbo with no support.
* **Doctors start visits blind**, leading to rushed decisions and missed symptoms.
* **Triage nurses are expensive and inefficient**, yet essential for collecting high-quality data.

Paratus solves these problems, ensuring patients feel heard before their visit and doctors can focus on diagnosis, not data collection.

### **What Patients Are Saying**

_"I called as a mother for my son’s ear pain. I was impressed by the AI’s clarity, empathy, and ability to ask the right questions. Honestly, it was better to talk to than a real nurse!"_

### **Why Us?**

Best friends Tannen Hall and Pablo Bermudez-Canete, both AI students from Stanford, founded Paratus Health to fix a problem they experienced firsthand—the broken patient intake process.

For 11 years, Tannen watched his family members - and himself - grow sicker without a diagnosis for a rare disease. They endured months-long waits for every appointment, only to leave with more questions than answers. Each new doctor started from scratch, missing critical details that could have led to the right diagnosis sooner. By the time they finally got answers, it was too late to undo the damage.

That experience left Tannen frustrated with a system that forces patients to wait in limbo while their health deteriorates. He wrote about this problem in his Stanford application, and today, there is no one more determined to fix it.

Now, he and Pablo are building Paratus, an AI-powered intake platform that ensures no patient is left waiting without support and no doctor walks in unprepared.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87836&key=user_uploads/1786718/3a9b560c-8f62-4376-9297-67a19ff14f04)

### **Our Vision**

A world where doctors walk in ready to diagnose, not gather symptoms- because every patient’s full story is already in their hands.

### **Our Ask**

We’re currently running pilots and looking to connect with:

* Hospitals
* Physician offices
* Outpatient facilities
* Private clinics

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/pablo-paratushealth/30min?month=2025-02)!

If you know someone who should see this, we’d love an introduction! Reach us at [pablo@paratushealth.com](https://mailto:pablo@paratushealth.com) or on [linkedin!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paratushealth/)

**Let’s fix patient intake - so doctors can focus on care.**

**We're Yash and Ishan, co-founders of Ergo.**

**Ergo is the revenue infrastructure for teams growing faster than their systems can keep up.** We connect the conversations your team is already having, across calls, email, Slack, and more, and build a unified data layer that moves deals forward.

Teams like [Rho](https://rho.co), [RetellAI](https://retellai.com), [Whop](https://whop.com), [Agency Cybersecurity](https://getagency.com), [Corgi](https://corgi.insure), and [Greptile](https://greptile.com) are already running on Ergo.

**📉 The Problem**

Revenue teams are drowning in fragmented data. Your reps are on six different communication channels. None of it connects. None of it acts on itself.

* Deals slip because no one followed up at the right moment
* Leadership asks reps what's happening instead of just knowing
* Marketing sequences run on empty fields because the right data never made it in
* AEs walk into calls without context because handoffs live in someone's Slack DMs

The conversations are happening. The signal is there. It just never goes anywhere.

**📈 The Solution**

Ergo plugs into every channel where your team talks to prospects and customers and builds a unified data layer across all of it. Every call, email, and message gets structured into a single source of truth your entire revenue org can act on.

* **For revenue teams:** Structured deal data captured automatically across every call, email, and message, without touching your CRM
* **For reps:** Follow-ups drafted and surfaced at the right moment, every time
* **For managers and founders:** Real-time pipeline visibility without chasing anyone for updates

1. **Connect your channels** — Zoom, Google Meet, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, dialers. Wherever your team talks to customers, Ergo listens.
2. **Structure the signal** — Every conversation becomes structured, actionable data across your pipeline.
3. **Execute on what's next** — Follow-ups drafted. Deals surfaced. Pipeline moving. No manual work required.

**🎬 Our Story**

We started at Georgia Tech, and got our first real signal at a YC-backed startup in SF. We spent four days embedded with their sales team and watched 15-20 daily calls evaporate into missed follow-ups and stale records. We built a first version over a weekend that unlocked $75K in closed contracts. That problem turned out to be everywhere.

Today Ergo supports revenue teams running their entire bottom-of-funnel motion, from first conversation to close to expansion, without the admin.

launches.body:
Hi everyone! It’s Jesse & Isabelle from Cedar :)

### How do we productise conversion optimisation?

In business terms, we do two things:

1. We let you understand your user’s stories at scale. What do they want from your solution? What are they specifically trying to do on your software? Who are they?
   1. We do this by pulling your existing analytics and adding a thin layer of our own. You can re-target churned users when a relevant feature comes out, inform product roadmaps, and most importantly use it to find PMF.

      ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87967&key=user_uploads/561766/7f7d6dc9-b759-454c-a897-e94b5dd76197)

2. We use those analytics to increase conversion & retention, from pre-sale to activation/onboarding and beyond.
   1. Create individualised sales materials and activation flows to bring more users to their magic moment.
   2. Instead of not knowing how to do X and being blocked until customer support replies (or worse, churning), Cedar instantly responds.

      ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87967&key=user_uploads/561766/aa9b2e93-ed62-469a-9f49-c1e4a1de8596)


Think of a general-use product like Notion. Imagine if every user saw a landing page that explains **exactly** how Notion helps them reach their goals. When they sign up, an activation flow walks them through solving a relevant problem they face every day. Then, as they use the app, an AI copilot makes them a power user, without the need to leave the app.

### Demo Video

<https://youtu.be/w73bNTbAjDg>

### Our story

In more personal terms, we find it deeply wrong that people make awesome, valuable software that doesn’t reach people simply because of things like UI/UX or messaging. We turn every user into a power user - with the retention and promoter scores that come with it.

While AI is scaling engineering teams, we’re going to be the growth and customer success team in one product, with one centralized source of user knowledge.

Jesse worked at Intuit, learning the science and fun of making boring software (don’t tell TurboTax) that converts and serves customers of all tech literacy levels.

Isabelle worked at Figma and Notion, learning the struggles of getting users to effectively use powerful yet complex products and the GTM strategies to reach them.

launches.body:
**Industrial Sales teams are underwater. Here’s why - and what we’re doing to fix it.**

Hi everyone! We’re [Smit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/smitdagli/) and [Vik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikhyath-m-a00357128/) - the founders of [Kanava AI](https://kanava.ai/)

**Problem and Opportunity:**

The wholesale distribution industry is massive: _$9T+ in annual revenue. 410,000+ businesses. 6 million+ employees._

And yet — sales teams are drowning.

* **A third of the workforce is over 55**, and replacements aren’t coming fast enough.

  (“Most of my sales reps are **retiring in the next 2-3 years**, I have **NO idea** what I’ll do after” - a medium sized electrical goods distributor from Indiana we met)
* **Reps spend less than 30% of their time selling**. The rest? Answering repetitive calls (“What’s the price of this SKU?” “Which warehouse has it?”), digging through systems, and manual follow-ups.
* **Over 25% of inbound calls never reach a human** — lost revenue, lost trust, lost time.

This isn’t just inefficiency. It’s operational drag at scale — and it's only getting worse.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8%5C%5C)

**How’re we solving it:**

We’re building Kanava AI, a voice-based AI agent designed for wholesale distributors.

It handles repetitive tasks like **answering stock, price,** and **order status calls** using live **ERP** data and logging **field notes hands-free**, drafting follow-ups, updating the **CRM** all _automatically_.

It’s like a junior rep-in-training. It starts with the basics, but improves quickly by learning from the company’s best performers. Over time, Kanava takes on more:

•⁠ **⁠Managing consultative sales calls** \
•⁠ ⁠**Identifying upsell opportunities** in real time \
•⁠ ⁠**Surfacing coaching insights** from rep conversations \
•⁠ ⁠**Re-engaging dormant accounts** with timely, data-backed outreach

And by the time these reps are ready to retire, Kanava is **ready to fill the void they leave.**

Most AI tools in this space fail because they try to do too much, too early, and distributors are famously late adopters. We’re taking a more deliberate path: start with low-leverage work, prove value, and scale responsibility as the system earns it.

**Our Team**

Vik (CTO) and Smit (CEO) know each other since freshman year of college at UC Berkeley. Both of us studied CS, and worked as AI engineers at various startups before deciding to build our own thing and join YC.

**Smit:** Built incident resolution agents at a series B observability startup called Observe. Previously worked at Abnormal Security and Salesforce.

**Vik**: Built voice agents for numerical data entry and hands-free navigation for a data management platform called Uncountable. Previously worked at Uber and Amazon.

We’re both outsiders to the wholesale distribution industry, but we’re listening hard and learning fast.

What made us really want to work together was being on the same ultimate frisbee team in the senior year of college - that team was a disaster, we lost every single game we played by huge margins, but despite that, we had a ton of fun and stuck together!

**Our Ask** If you know any **distributors, field sales heavy businesses or IMR’s (Independent Manufacturer Reps)**, we’d appreciate a connection at [smit@kanava.ai](mailto:smit@kanava.ai) or [vikhyath@kanava.ai](mailto:vikhyath@kanava.ai). We’ll make their lives a lot easier and buy you a coffee ☕🤎

**TL;DR**

Most companies don't have the time or technical expertise to build custom AI automations. LemonLime connects to your existing tools, studies your business, and builds specialized automations for you — actual outcomes, fast.

Every small business knows they should be "using AI," but almost none of them can. We learned this firsthand doing custom AI consulting for businesses. After building workflows for a handful of customers, two things immediately became obvious:

1. The context AI needs to succeed is scattered — files, documents, chat threads, you name it. Searching for and organizing this information was 95% of the work, every single time.

Small businesses need impact out-of-the-box, they don’t have the time or capital to spend on fancy AI initiatives that aren’t creating value from day one.

launches.tagline: Make every rep sell like your best one: door-to-door, in-home, showroom.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Mathieu, Thomas and Nicolas, two brothers and a best friend building COACH.

**TL;DR:** We're building the best coach for in-person sales ever built: reps record every in-person meeting from our app, and our AI turns it into precise, personalized coaching. And it works so well that 5 months in, thousands of reps already run on COACH, and we're live with the top 5 in-person sales companies in France, lifting conversion rates by 32% on average.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yJB7wC3ddTM>

## The Problem

85% of sales in the world happen face-to-face. And in-person selling is brutally hard: a rep alone in someone's living room, reading signals, handling doubts, feeling the exact moment to push.

The best reps catch what no playbook can teach. That's why 20% of them bring in 80% of the revenue, and nobody knows what they're doing differently. The only way to find out is to physically be there: a ride-along, a full day, 100 km of driving to watch a single meeting. It doesn't scale.

## The Solution

COACH's AI learns how to close customers for your business, and closes the gap at every layer of the sales org:

* **Every rep gets a personal coach:** they record every in-person meeting from our mobile app, in-home, showroom, door-to-door, and walk out of each one with personal, precise feedback and a clear path to the next close. Our AI learns from your top 20% and coaches everyone to perform like them, starting each day with a morning brief on their weakest point. 90% improve on it in their first week.
* **The company gets a sales brain that learns how to close its customers:** every meeting feeds it. Why is one region closing twice as much as another? Which objection is killing deals this month? Leadership just asks, COACH has the answer.

Thousands of reps already run on COACH, live with the top 5 in-person sales companies in France, where we've lifted conversion rates by 32% on average, and dozens of reps 3–4×'d their numbers. We're now growing fast in the USA, where our first customers are switching from virtual ride-along platforms to COACH.

Every rep gets a coach. Your company gets a brain.

## The Team

At 18 and 21, we built Alsace Test: a 44-rep field sales team that did €3.5M in 14 months. Alsace made us fall in love with in-person sales, obsessed, actually.

And one thing was driving us crazy: same product, same material, same training, and one guy closed 4× more than the others. We were driving 2,000 km a week just to watch reps sell.

So we asked them to record themselves. Suddenly, without moving, we were listening to 10 hours of meetings a day. That was COACH before COACH.

In an AI-driven sales world, we're deeply convinced Zoom sales and call centers will soon be replaced by AI agents. Face-to-face selling will be the last human job on Earth. We're betting on it.

## Our Ask

If you run 5+ field sales reps, let's talk, we'll show you how to make them superhuman.

👋 Hey friends, we're Nazz and Francisco. We spent years at HubSpot running its three largest customer platforms, and we're backed by HubSpot founder Dharmesh Shah.

**The problem: general-purpose agents aren't built for high-volume GTM**

The best GTM engineers can wire HubSpot, Clay, Outreach, Gong, and Slack into agents that run a revenue team. But run that same work through a general agent and it re-reasons every step, burns your entire weekly limit overnight, and still isn't reliable at volume. Almost nobody can hire enough GTM engineers to do it properly.

**How Nex works**

Describe a goal, and Nex builds and runs the workflow across 1000+ integrations:

* Lead generation, qualification, and enrichment
* Scraping public records
* Outbound over email and socials
* CRM cleanup and hygiene
* Re-engaging lost deals

Because most GTM work is repetitive and deterministic, Nex has AI write code for the predictable parts and run it fast without wasting tokens, saving AI judgment for the genuinely hard parts. That's how it breezes through high-volume work while not burning through your monthly AI budget in a day.

**What that looks like**

On a single onboarding call, Nex audited thousands of records in a customer's HubSpot, flagged missing data, archived owners, bad associations, and zombie deals, and started fixing them before the call was over.

**Why this matters**
